from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"


@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int


class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col


def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col


COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")


class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())


def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def type_name(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "bool"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return "int"
    return "str"


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


class Interpreter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.env = {}
        self.output = []

    def run(self, program):
        for stmt in program.stmts:
            self.execute(stmt)

    def execute(self, stmt):
        if isinstance(stmt, Let):
            self.env[stmt.name] = self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Assign):
            if stmt.name not in self.env:
                raise CometError(f"assignment to undeclared variable {stmt.name}")
            self.env[stmt.name] = self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Print):
            self.output.append(show(self.evaluate(stmt.expr)))
        elif isinstance(stmt, ExprStmt):
            self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
        elif isinstance(stmt, If):
            if self.condition(stmt.cond):
                self.execute(stmt.then)
            elif stmt.else_ is not None:
                self.execute(stmt.else_)
        elif isinstance(stmt, While):
            while self.condition(stmt.cond):
                self.execute(stmt.body)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Block):
            for inner in stmt.stmts:
                self.execute(inner)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(stmt).__name__} is not supported yet")

    def condition(self, expr):
        value = self.evaluate(expr)
        if not isinstance(value, bool):
            raise CometError(f"condition must be bool, not {type_name(value)}")
        return value

    def evaluate(self, expr):
        if isinstance(expr, (Num, Str, Bool)):
            return expr.value
        if isinstance(expr, Var):
            if expr.name not in self.env:
                raise CometError(f"undefined variable {expr.name}")
            return self.env[expr.name]
        if isinstance(expr, Unary):
            value = self.evaluate(expr.expr)
            if expr.op == "-":
                self.need("int", value, "-")
                return -value
            self.need("bool", value, "not")
            return not value
        if isinstance(expr, Binary):
            return self.binary(expr)
        raise CometError(f"{type(expr).__name__} is not supported yet")

    def need(self, wanted, value, op):
        if type_name(value) != wanted:
            raise CometError(f"'{op}' needs {wanted}, not {type_name(value)}")

    def binary(self, expr):
        op = expr.op
        left = self.evaluate(expr.left)
        if op in ("and", "or"):
            self.need("bool", left, op)
            if (op == "and" and not left) or (op == "or" and left):
                return left
            right = self.evaluate(expr.right)
            self.need("bool", right, op)
            return right
        right = self.evaluate(expr.right)
        if op in ("==", "!="):
            if type_name(left) != type_name(right):
                raise CometError(f"cannot compare {type_name(left)} with {type_name(right)}")
            return (left == right) == (op == "==")
        if op == "+" and type_name(left) == "str" and type_name(right) == "str":
            return left + right
        self.need("int", left, op)
        self.need("int", right, op)
        if op == "+":
            return left + right
        if op == "-":
            return left - right
        if op == "*":
            return left * right
        if op == "/":
            return comet_div(left, right)
        if op == "%":
            return comet_mod(left, right)
        if op == "<":
            return left < right
        if op == "<=":
            return left <= right
        if op == ">":
            return left > right
        return left >= right


class FuelInterpreter(Interpreter):
    def __init__(self, fuel):
        super().__init__()
        self.fuel = fuel
        self.used = 0

    def spend(self):
        if self.used == self.fuel:
            raise CometError("out of fuel")
        self.used += 1

    def execute(self, stmt):
        if not isinstance(stmt, Block):
            self.spend()
        if isinstance(stmt, While):
            while True:
                self.spend()
                if not self.condition(stmt.cond):
                    break
                self.execute(stmt.body)
        else:
            super().execute(stmt)


def run_with_fuel(source, fuel):
    interp = FuelInterpreter(fuel)
    try:
        interp.run(parse_program(tokenize(source)))
    except CometError as e:
        return interp.output, interp.used, str(e)
    return interp.output, interp.used, None
--- hint
Subclass `Interpreter` with a counter and a `spend()` method that raises "out of fuel" when the counter already equals the budget, and otherwise adds 1. Override `execute` to call `spend()` first for every statement except a `Block`, then let the parent class do the work.
--- hint
The parent's `while` loop checks its condition without paying, so handle `While` yourself in the override: loop forever, call `spend()`, evaluate the condition with `self.condition(...)`, stop when it is false, otherwise execute the body.
--- check case | The first example from the task
run_with_fuel("let i = 0; while i < 3 { i = i + 1; }", 9)
=> ([], 9, None)
--- check case | One unit short
run_with_fuel("let i = 0; while i < 3 { i = i + 1; }", 8)
=> ([], 8, "out of fuel")
--- check case | Output before the fuel runs out is kept
run_with_fuel("print 1; print 2; print 3;", 2)
=> (["1", "2"], 2, "out of fuel")
--- check case | Zero fuel runs nothing; an empty program needs none
(run_with_fuel("print 1;", 0), run_with_fuel("", 0))
=> (([], 0, "out of fuel"), ([], 0, None))
--- check case | if costs 1, blocks cost nothing, and only the chosen branch runs
run_with_fuel("if true { print 1; } else { print 2; print 3; }", 100)
=> (["1"], 2, None)
--- check case | An endless loop is stopped
run_with_fuel("while true { }", 50)
=> ([], 50, "out of fuel")
--- check case | Other runtime errors are reported with the units used so far
run_with_fuel("print 1; print 1 / 0;", 10)
=> (["1"], 2, "division by zero")

+++ practice | A read-eval-print loop
--- task
A **REPL** (read, evaluate, print, loop) lets you type code one piece at a time and see results at once, like Python's `>>>` prompt. Write `repl(chunks)` that simulates a REPL session for Comet. `chunks` is a list of source strings, each one typed at the prompt. The starter gives the lexer, the parser, the lesson's complete interpreter, and its helper `show(value)`.

- Use **one** `Interpreter` for the whole session, so variables declared in one chunk exist in the next.
- If a chunk is exactly one expression statement, such as `x * 2;`, evaluate its expression once and add `show(value)` to the transcript, the way Python echoes `>>> x * 2`.
- Otherwise run the chunk's statements; each line they print goes to the transcript.
- If a chunk raises a `LexError`, `ParseError` or `CometError`, first add any lines it printed before the error, then add `"error: "` followed by `str(error)`, and carry on with the next chunk. Changes the chunk made before the error are kept.

Return the transcript, a list of strings. For example, `repl(["let x = 4;", "x * 2;", "print x; print y;", "x = x + 1;", "x;"])` is `["8", "4", "error: undefined variable y", "5"]`.
--- starter
from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"


@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int


class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col


def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col


COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")


class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())


def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def type_name(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "bool"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return "int"
    return "str"


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


class Interpreter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.env = {}
        self.output = []

    def run(self, program):
        for stmt in program.stmts:
            self.execute(stmt)

    def execute(self, stmt):
        if isinstance(stmt, Let):
            self.env[stmt.name] = self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Assign):
            if stmt.name not in self.env:
                raise CometError(f"assignment to undeclared variable {stmt.name}")
            self.env[stmt.name] = self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Print):
            self.output.append(show(self.evaluate(stmt.expr)))
        elif isinstance(stmt, ExprStmt):
            self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
        elif isinstance(stmt, If):
            if self.condition(stmt.cond):
                self.execute(stmt.then)
            elif stmt.else_ is not None:
                self.execute(stmt.else_)
        elif isinstance(stmt, While):
            while self.condition(stmt.cond):
                self.execute(stmt.body)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Block):
            for inner in stmt.stmts:
                self.execute(inner)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(stmt).__name__} is not supported yet")

    def condition(self, expr):
        value = self.evaluate(expr)
        if not isinstance(value, bool):
            raise CometError(f"condition must be bool, not {type_name(value)}")
        return value

    def evaluate(self, expr):
        if isinstance(expr, (Num, Str, Bool)):
            return expr.value
        if isinstance(expr, Var):
            if expr.name not in self.env:
                raise CometError(f"undefined variable {expr.name}")
            return self.env[expr.name]
        if isinstance(expr, Unary):
            value = self.evaluate(expr.expr)
            if expr.op == "-":
                self.need("int", value, "-")
                return -value
            self.need("bool", value, "not")
            return not value
        if isinstance(expr, Binary):
            return self.binary(expr)
        raise CometError(f"{type(expr).__name__} is not supported yet")

    def need(self, wanted, value, op):
        if type_name(value) != wanted:
            raise CometError(f"'{op}' needs {wanted}, not {type_name(value)}")

    def binary(self, expr):
        op = expr.op
        left = self.evaluate(expr.left)
        if op in ("and", "or"):
            self.need("bool", left, op)
            if (op == "and" and not left) or (op == "or" and left):
                return left
            right = self.evaluate(expr.right)
            self.need("bool", right, op)
            return right
        right = self.evaluate(expr.right)
        if op in ("==", "!="):
            if type_name(left) != type_name(right):
                raise CometError(f"cannot compare {type_name(left)} with {type_name(right)}")
            return (left == right) == (op == "==")
        if op == "+" and type_name(left) == "str" and type_name(right) == "str":
            return left + right
        self.need("int", left, op)
        self.need("int", right, op)
        if op == "+":
            return left + right
        if op == "-":
            return left - right
        if op == "*":
            return left * right
        if op == "/":
            return comet_div(left, right)
        if op == "%":
            return comet_mod(left, right)
        if op == "<":
            return left < right
        if op == "<=":
            return left <= right
        if op == ">":
            return left > right
        return left >= right


def repl(chunks):
    return []

from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"


@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int


class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col


def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col


COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")


class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())


def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()

class Interpreter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.env = {}
        self.output = []

    def run(self, program):
        for stmt in program.stmts:
            self.execute(stmt)

    def execute(self, stmt):
        if isinstance(stmt, Let):
            self.env[stmt.name] = self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Assign):
            if stmt.name not in self.env:
                raise CometError(f"assignment to undeclared variable {stmt.name}")
            self.env[stmt.name] = self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Print):
            self.output.append(show(self.evaluate(stmt.expr)))
        elif isinstance(stmt, ExprStmt):
            self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
        elif isinstance(stmt, If):
            if self.condition(stmt.cond):
                self.execute(stmt.then)
            elif stmt.else_ is not None:
                self.execute(stmt.else_)
        elif isinstance(stmt, While):
            while self.condition(stmt.cond):
                self.execute(stmt.body)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Block):
            for inner in stmt.stmts:
                self.execute(inner)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(stmt).__name__} is not supported yet")

    def condition(self, expr):
        value = self.evaluate(expr)
        if not isinstance(value, bool):
            raise CometError(f"condition must be bool, not {type_name(value)}")
        return value

    def evaluate(self, expr):
        if isinstance(expr, (Num, Str, Bool)):
            return expr.value
        if isinstance(expr, Var):
            if expr.name not in self.env:
                raise CometError(f"undefined variable {expr.name}")
            return self.env[expr.name]
        if isinstance(expr, Unary):
            value = self.evaluate(expr.expr)
            if expr.op == "-":
                self.need("int", value, "-")
                return -value
            self.need("bool", value, "not")
            return not value
        if isinstance(expr, Binary):
            return self.binary(expr)
        raise CometError(f"{type(expr).__name__} is not supported yet")

    def need(self, wanted, value, op):
        if type_name(value) != wanted:
            raise CometError(f"'{op}' needs {wanted}, not {type_name(value)}")

    def binary(self, expr):
        op = expr.op
        left = self.evaluate(expr.left)
        if op in ("and", "or"):
            self.need("bool", left, op)
            if (op == "and" and not left) or (op == "or" and left):
                return left
            right = self.evaluate(expr.right)
            self.need("bool", right, op)
            return right
        right = self.evaluate(expr.right)
        if op in ("==", "!="):
            if type_name(left) != type_name(right):
                raise CometError(f"cannot compare {type_name(left)} with {type_name(right)}")
            return (left == right) == (op == "==")
        if op == "+" and type_name(left) == "str" and type_name(right) == "str":
            return left + right
        self.need("int", left, op)
        self.need("int", right, op)
        if op == "+":
            return left + right
        if op == "-":
            return left - right
        if op == "*":
            return left * right
        if op == "/":
            return comet_div(left, right)
        if op == "%":
            return comet_mod(left, right)
        if op == "<":
            return left < right
        if op == "<=":
            return left <= right
        if op == ">":
            return left > right
        return left >= right


def repl(chunks):
    interp = Interpreter()
    transcript = []
    for chunk in chunks:
        start = len(interp.output)
        error = None
        try:
            program = parse_program(tokenize(chunk))
            if len(program.stmts) == 1 and isinstance(program.stmts[0], ExprStmt):
                interp.output.append(show(interp.evaluate(program.stmts[0].expr)))
            else:
                interp.run(program)
        except (LexError, ParseError, CometError) as e:
            error = f"error: {e}"
        transcript.extend(interp.output[start:])
        if error is not None:
            transcript.append(error)
    return transcript
--- hint
Create the `Interpreter` before the loop. For each chunk, remember `len(interp.output)` first, so that afterwards `interp.output[start:]` is exactly what this chunk printed.
--- hint
Parse the chunk inside `try`. When `program.stmts` has one statement and it is an `ExprStmt`, evaluate its expression with `interp.evaluate` and append `show(value)`. Catch all three error classes in one `except (LexError, ParseError, CometError) as e`, and add the error line after the chunk's printed lines.

+++ practice | Comet's values, exactly
--- task
The interpreter's correctness rests on a few small functions that must follow Comet's rules exactly, not Python's. Write four of them, for Comet values stored as Python `int`, `bool` and `str`. Raise `CometError` (in the starter) whenever Comet's rules say the operation is an error.

- `show(v)`: the text `print` writes: an int's digits (with `-` if negative), `"true"` or `"false"` for a bool, and a string's own characters.
- `equal(a, b)`: Comet's `==`: `True` or `False` when `a` and `b` have the same Comet type, and an error otherwise.
- `add(a, b)`: Comet's `+`: the sum of two ints, or two strings joined; an error for any other pair.
- `less(a, b)`: Comet's `<`: only for two ints; an error otherwise.

Watch the edges. In Python, `True == 1`, `True + True == 2`, `False < 2`, and `isinstance(True, int)` is true; none of these may leak through. For example, `add(True, True)` and `equal(0, False)` both raise `CometError`, while `show("true")` is `"true"`, the same text as `show(True)`.
--- starter

    pass

    return str(v)

    return a == b


def add(a, b):
    return a + b


def less(a, b):
    return a < b

class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_type(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return "bool"
    if isinstance(v, int):
        return "int"
    return "str"


def show(v):
    if comet_type(v) == "bool":
        return "true" if v else "false"
    return str(v)


def equal(a, b):
    if comet_type(a) != comet_type(b):
        raise CometError(f"cannot compare {comet_type(a)} with {comet_type(b)}")
    return a == b


def add(a, b):
    if comet_type(a) == comet_type(b) and comet_type(a) in ("int", "str"):
        return a + b
    raise CometError(f"cannot add {comet_type(a)} and {comet_type(b)}")


def less(a, b):
    if comet_type(a) == "int" and comet_type(b) == "int":
        return a < b
    raise CometError(f"'<' needs two ints, not {comet_type(a)} and {comet_type(b)}")
--- hint
Write one helper that returns a value's Comet type as a word, testing `bool` first. Then every function checks the types with it before it does anything with the values.
--- hint
`add` accepts two ints or two strings, and nothing else: in particular not two bools. `less` accepts only two ints. `equal` accepts any pair whose two types are the same word.
--- check case | show for every type, including the tricky ones
(show(42), show(-7), show(True), show(False), show("true"), show(""), show("a b"))
=> ("42", "-7", "true", "false", "true", "", "a b")
--- check case | equal within one type

=> (True, False, True, False, True)
--- check test | equal across types is an error, even when Python says equal

=> (5, 0, "ab", "", 100000000000000000001)

+++ practice | Debug: and that does not wait
--- task
The starter's interpreter runs Comet programs, but a program that relies on short-circuiting crashes. `let n = 0; print n != 0 and 10 / n > 1;` should print `false`, because the division must never happen when `n` is 0. Instead it stops with "division by zero". In the same way, `print true or missing;` should print `true`, but stops with "undefined variable missing".

from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"


@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int


class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col


def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col


COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")


class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())


def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def type_name(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "bool"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return "int"
    return "str"


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


class Interpreter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.env = {}
        self.output = []

    def run(self, program):
        for stmt in program.stmts:
            self.execute(stmt)

    def execute(self, stmt):
        if isinstance(stmt, Let):
            self.env[stmt.name] = self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Assign):
            if stmt.name not in self.env:
                raise CometError(f"assignment to undeclared variable {stmt.name}")
            self.env[stmt.name] = self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Print):
            self.output.append(show(self.evaluate(stmt.expr)))
        elif isinstance(stmt, ExprStmt):
            self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
        elif isinstance(stmt, If):
            if self.condition(stmt.cond):
                self.execute(stmt.then)
            elif stmt.else_ is not None:
                self.execute(stmt.else_)
        elif isinstance(stmt, While):
            while self.condition(stmt.cond):
                self.execute(stmt.body)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Block):
            for inner in stmt.stmts:
                self.execute(inner)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(stmt).__name__} is not supported yet")

    def condition(self, expr):
        value = self.evaluate(expr)
        if not isinstance(value, bool):
            raise CometError(f"condition must be bool, not {type_name(value)}")
        return value

    def evaluate(self, expr):
        if isinstance(expr, (Num, Str, Bool)):
            return expr.value
        if isinstance(expr, Var):
            if expr.name not in self.env:
                raise CometError(f"undefined variable {expr.name}")
            return self.env[expr.name]
        if isinstance(expr, Unary):
            value = self.evaluate(expr.expr)
            if expr.op == "-":
                self.need("int", value, "-")
                return -value
            self.need("bool", value, "not")
            return not value
        if isinstance(expr, Binary):
            return self.binary(expr)
        raise CometError(f"{type(expr).__name__} is not supported yet")

    def need(self, wanted, value, op):
        if type_name(value) != wanted:
            raise CometError(f"'{op}' needs {wanted}, not {type_name(value)}")

    def binary(self, expr):
        op = expr.op
        left = self.evaluate(expr.left)
        right = self.evaluate(expr.right)
        if op in ("and", "or"):
            self.need("bool", left, op)
            if (op == "and" and not left) or (op == "or" and left):
                return left
            self.need("bool", right, op)
            return right
        if op in ("==", "!="):
            if type_name(left) != type_name(right):
                raise CometError(f"cannot compare {type_name(left)} with {type_name(right)}")
            return (left == right) == (op == "==")
        if op == "+" and type_name(left) == "str" and type_name(right) == "str":
            return left + right
        self.need("int", left, op)
        self.need("int", right, op)
        if op == "+":
            return left + right
        if op == "-":
            return left - right
        if op == "*":
            return left * right
        if op == "/":
            return comet_div(left, right)
        if op == "%":
            return comet_mod(left, right)
        if op == "<":
            return left < right
        if op == "<=":
            return left <= right
        if op == ">":
            return left > right
        return left >= right


def run_source(source):
    interp = Interpreter()
    try:
        interp.run(parse_program(tokenize(source)))
    except CometError as e:
        return interp.output, str(e)
    return interp.output, None

from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"


@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int


class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col


def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens
