class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col


COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")


class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())


def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


MAX_DEPTH = 40


class Closure:
    def __init__(self, decl, env):
        self.decl = decl
        self.env = env


class ReturnSignal(Exception):
    def __init__(self, value):
        super().__init__("return")
        self.value = value


def type_name(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "bool"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return "int"
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return "str"
    if isinstance(value, Closure):
        return "fn"

    return "nothing"


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    if isinstance(value, Closure):
        return f"<fn {value.decl.name}>"

    if value is None:
        raise CometError("cannot print nothing")
    return str(value)


class Environment:
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        self.values = {}
        self.parent = parent

    def define(self, name, value):
        if name in self.values:
            raise CometError(f"{name} is already declared in this scope")
        self.values[name] = value

    def find(self, name):
        env = self
        while env is not None:
            if name in env.values:
                return env
            env = env.parent
        return None

    def lookup(self, name):
        env = self.find(name)
        if env is None:
            raise CometError(f"undefined variable {name}")
        return env.values[name]

    def assign(self, name, value):
        env = self.find(name)
        if env is None:
            raise CometError(f"assignment to undeclared variable {name}")
        env.values[name] = value


class Interpreter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.globals = Environment()
        self.env = self.globals
        self.output = []
        self.frames = []


    def run(self, program):
        for stmt in program.stmts:
            self.execute(stmt)

    def execute_block(self, stmts, env):
        previous = self.env
        self.env = env
        try:
            for stmt in stmts:
                self.execute(stmt)
        finally:
            self.env = previous

    def execute(self, stmt):
        if isinstance(stmt, Let):
            self.env.define(stmt.name, self.evaluate(stmt.expr))
        elif isinstance(stmt, Assign):
            value = self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
            self.env.assign(stmt.name, value)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Print):
            self.output.append(show(self.evaluate(stmt.expr)))
        elif isinstance(stmt, ExprStmt):
            self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
        elif isinstance(stmt, If):
            if self.condition(stmt.cond):
                self.execute(stmt.then)
            elif stmt.else_ is not None:
                self.execute(stmt.else_)
        elif isinstance(stmt, While):
            while self.condition(stmt.cond):
                self.execute(stmt.body)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Block):
            self.execute_block(stmt.stmts, Environment(self.env))
        elif isinstance(stmt, Fn):
            self.env.define(stmt.name, Closure(stmt, self.env))
        elif isinstance(stmt, Return):
            if not self.frames:
                raise CometError("return outside a function")
            value = None if stmt.expr is None else self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
            raise ReturnSignal(value)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(stmt).__name__} is not supported yet")

    def condition(self, expr):
        value = self.evaluate(expr)
        if not isinstance(value, bool):
            raise CometError(f"condition must be bool, not {type_name(value)}")
        return value

    def evaluate(self, expr):
        if isinstance(expr, (Num, Str, Bool)):
            return expr.value
        if isinstance(expr, Var):
            return self.env.lookup(expr.name)
        if isinstance(expr, Unary):
            value = self.evaluate(expr.expr)
            if expr.op == "-":
                self.need("int", value, "-")
                return -value
            self.need("bool", value, "not")
            return not value
        if isinstance(expr, Binary):
            return self.binary(expr)
        if isinstance(expr, Call):
            callee = self.evaluate(expr.callee)
            args = [self.evaluate(arg) for arg in expr.args]
            return self.call(callee, args)
        raise CometError(f"{type(expr).__name__} is not supported yet")

    def call(self, callee, args):
        if not isinstance(callee, Closure):
            raise CometError(f"cannot call a value of type {type_name(callee)}")
        decl = callee.decl
        if len(args) != len(decl.params):
            raise CometError(f"{decl.name} expects {len(decl.params)} arguments, got {len(args)}")
        if len(self.frames) >= MAX_DEPTH:
            raise CometError("stack overflow")
        env = Environment(callee.env)
        for (name, _), value in zip(decl.params, args):
            env.define(name, value)
        self.frames.append(decl.name)
        try:
            self.execute_block(decl.body.stmts, env)
        except ReturnSignal as signal:
            return signal.value
        finally:
            self.frames.pop()
        return None

    def need(self, wanted, value, op):
        if type_name(value) != wanted:
            raise CometError(f"'{op}' needs {wanted}, not {type_name(value)}")

    def binary(self, expr):
        op = expr.op
        left = self.evaluate(expr.left)
        if op in ("and", "or"):
            self.need("bool", left, op)
            if (op == "and" and not left) or (op == "or" and left):
                return left
            right = self.evaluate(expr.right)
            self.need("bool", right, op)
            return right
        right = self.evaluate(expr.right)
        if op in ("==", "!="):
            if type_name(left) != type_name(right):
                raise CometError(f"cannot compare {type_name(left)} with {type_name(right)}")
            return (left is right if isinstance(left, Closure) else left == right) == (op == "==")
        if op == "+" and type_name(left) == "str" and type_name(right) == "str":
            return left + right
        self.need("int", left, op)
        self.need("int", right, op)
        if op == "+":
            return left + right
        if op == "-":
            return left - right
        if op == "*":
            return left * right
        if op == "/":
            return comet_div(left, right)
        if op == "%":
            return comet_mod(left, right)
        if op == "<":
            return left < right
        if op == "<=":
            return left <= right
        if op == ">":
            return left > right
        return left >= right


def run_source(source):
    interp = Interpreter()
    try:
        interp.run(parse_program(tokenize(source)))
    except CometError as e:
        return interp.output, str(e)
    return interp.output, None


class Resolver:
    def __init__(self):
        self.scopes = [set()]
        self.top_level = set()
        self.functions = 0
        self.errors = []

    def resolve(self, program):
        for stmt in program.stmts:
            if isinstance(stmt, (Let, Fn)):
                self.top_level.add(stmt.name)
        self.statements(program.stmts)
        return self.errors

    def declare(self, name):
        if name in self.scopes[-1]:
            self.errors.append(f"{name} is already declared in this scope")
        self.scopes[-1].add(name)

    def use(self, node, name, message):
        for i in range(len(self.scopes) - 1, 0, -1):
            if name in self.scopes[i]:
                node.depth = len(self.scopes) - 1 - i
                return
        node.depth = None
        if name in self.scopes[0]:
            return
        if self.functions > 0 and name in self.top_level:
            return
        self.errors.append(f"{message} {name}")

    def statements(self, stmts):
        for stmt in stmts:
            self.stmt(stmt)

    def block(self, stmts):
        self.scopes.append(set())
        self.statements(stmts)
        self.scopes.pop()

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, Let):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.declare(s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Assign):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.use(s, s.name, "assignment to undeclared variable")
        elif isinstance(s, (Print, ExprStmt)):
            self.expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            self.expr(s.cond)
            self.stmt(s.then)
            if s.else_ is not None:
                self.stmt(s.else_)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            self.expr(s.cond)
            self.stmt(s.body)
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            self.block(s.stmts)
        elif isinstance(s, Return):
            if self.functions == 0:
                self.errors.append("return outside a function")
            if s.expr is not None:
                self.expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, Fn):
            self.declare(s.name)
            self.function(s)

    def function(self, s):
        self.functions += 1
        self.scopes.append(set())
        for name, _ in s.params:
            self.declare(name)
        self.statements(s.body.stmts)
        self.scopes.pop()
        self.functions -= 1

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            self.use(e, e.name, "undefined variable")
        elif isinstance(e, Unary):
            self.expr(e.expr)
        elif isinstance(e, Binary):
            self.expr(e.left)
            self.expr(e.right)
        elif isinstance(e, Call):
            self.expr(e.callee)
            for arg in e.args:
                self.expr(arg)


class ResolvedInterpreter(Interpreter):
    """The lesson 8 interpreter, reading and assigning variables at the distances the resolver found."""

    def evaluate(self, expr):
        if isinstance(expr, Var):
            return self.at(expr).values[expr.name] if expr.depth is not None else self.globals.lookup(expr.name)
        return super().evaluate(expr)

    def execute(self, stmt):
        if isinstance(stmt, Assign):
            value = self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
            if stmt.depth is not None:
                self.at(stmt).values[stmt.name] = value
            else:
                self.globals.assign(stmt.name, value)
            return
        super().execute(stmt)

    def at(self, node):
        env = self.env
        for _ in range(node.depth):
            env = env.parent
        return env


def check(source):
    return Resolver().resolve(parse_program(tokenize(source)))


def run_resolved(source):
    program = parse_program(tokenize(source))
    errors = Resolver().resolve(program)
    if errors:
        return [], errors[0]
    interp = ResolvedInterpreter()
    try:
        interp.run(program)
    except CometError as e:
        return interp.output, str(e)
    return interp.output, None
--- hint
In which order does the `Let` case declare the name and resolve the right-hand side? Which order does the scope rule require?
--- hint
A declaration's scope starts after the `let`. Resolve the expression first, then declare the name.
--- check test | The top-level program from the task
check("let y = y;") == ["undefined variable y"]
--- check case | The block program from the task
run_resolved("let x = 10; if true { let x = x + 1; print x; } print x;")
=> (["11", "10"], None)
--- check test | Inside functions too
check("fn f(n) { let n2 = n2 + 1; return n; }") == ["undefined variable n2"] and run_resolved("fn f(v) { if true { let v = v * 2; return v; } } print f(4);") == (["8"], None)
--- check test | Normal declarations still work
check("let a = 1; let b = a + 1; print b;") == [] and check("let a = 1; let a = 2;") == ["a is already declared in this scope"]

+++ practice | Local functions that call each other
--- task
Top-level functions may call each other thanks to late binding, but local functions may not: in `fn outer() { fn a() { return b(); } fn b() { return 1; } return a(); }`, the resolver reports "undefined variable b". OCaml's `let rec … and …` and Haskell's `where` let a group of local functions refer to each other. Add the same to Comet: a run of **consecutive** `fn` statements in one statement list (the program, a block, or a function body) forms a group, and all the names of a group are declared before any of the group's bodies is resolved.

The starter gives the lesson's finished resolver and interpreter. Change the resolver so that:

- inside a group, every function may use every name of the group, in any order;
- a statement between two functions splits them into two groups, so `fn a() { return b(); } a(); fn b() { return 1; }` inside a block still reports "undefined variable b";
- a name declared twice in one scope is still reported, for example two functions of one group with the same name, or a `let` and a later `fn` with the same name.

The interpreter needs no change: when a group's functions run, all of them have been defined in the same environment. For example, `run_resolved` of a function containing local `even` and `odd` that call each other must work.
--- starter
from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"


@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int


class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col


def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col


COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")


class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())


def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


MAX_DEPTH = 40


class Closure:
    def __init__(self, decl, env):
        self.decl = decl
        self.env = env


class ReturnSignal(Exception):
    def __init__(self, value):
        super().__init__("return")
        self.value = value


def type_name(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "bool"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return "int"
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return "str"
    if isinstance(value, Closure):
        return "fn"

    return "nothing"


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    if isinstance(value, Closure):
        return f"<fn {value.decl.name}>"

    if value is None:
        raise CometError("cannot print nothing")
    return str(value)


class Environment:
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        self.values = {}
        self.parent = parent

    def define(self, name, value):
        if name in self.values:
            raise CometError(f"{name} is already declared in this scope")
        self.values[name] = value

    def find(self, name):
        env = self
        while env is not None:
            if name in env.values:
                return env
            env = env.parent
        return None

    def lookup(self, name):
        env = self.find(name)
        if env is None:
            raise CometError(f"undefined variable {name}")
        return env.values[name]

    def assign(self, name, value):
        env = self.find(name)
        if env is None:
            raise CometError(f"assignment to undeclared variable {name}")
        env.values[name] = value


class Interpreter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.globals = Environment()
        self.env = self.globals
        self.output = []
        self.frames = []


    def run(self, program):
        for stmt in program.stmts:
            self.execute(stmt)

    def execute_block(self, stmts, env):
        previous = self.env
        self.env = env
        try:
            for stmt in stmts:
                self.execute(stmt)
        finally:
            self.env = previous

    def execute(self, stmt):
        if isinstance(stmt, Let):
            self.env.define(stmt.name, self.evaluate(stmt.expr))
        elif isinstance(stmt, Assign):
            value = self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
            self.env.assign(stmt.name, value)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Print):
            self.output.append(show(self.evaluate(stmt.expr)))
        elif isinstance(stmt, ExprStmt):
            self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
        elif isinstance(stmt, If):
            if self.condition(stmt.cond):
                self.execute(stmt.then)
            elif stmt.else_ is not None:
                self.execute(stmt.else_)
        elif isinstance(stmt, While):
            while self.condition(stmt.cond):
                self.execute(stmt.body)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Block):
            self.execute_block(stmt.stmts, Environment(self.env))
        elif isinstance(stmt, Fn):
            self.env.define(stmt.name, Closure(stmt, self.env))
        elif isinstance(stmt, Return):
            if not self.frames:
                raise CometError("return outside a function")
            value = None if stmt.expr is None else self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
            raise ReturnSignal(value)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(stmt).__name__} is not supported yet")

    def condition(self, expr):
        value = self.evaluate(expr)
        if not isinstance(value, bool):
            raise CometError(f"condition must be bool, not {type_name(value)}")
        return value

    def evaluate(self, expr):
        if isinstance(expr, (Num, Str, Bool)):
            return expr.value
        if isinstance(expr, Var):
            return self.env.lookup(expr.name)
        if isinstance(expr, Unary):
            value = self.evaluate(expr.expr)
            if expr.op == "-":
                self.need("int", value, "-")
                return -value
            self.need("bool", value, "not")
            return not value
        if isinstance(expr, Binary):
            return self.binary(expr)
        if isinstance(expr, Call):
            callee = self.evaluate(expr.callee)
            args = [self.evaluate(arg) for arg in expr.args]
            return self.call(callee, args)
        raise CometError(f"{type(expr).__name__} is not supported yet")

    def call(self, callee, args):
        if not isinstance(callee, Closure):
            raise CometError(f"cannot call a value of type {type_name(callee)}")
        decl = callee.decl
        if len(args) != len(decl.params):
            raise CometError(f"{decl.name} expects {len(decl.params)} arguments, got {len(args)}")
        if len(self.frames) >= MAX_DEPTH:
            raise CometError("stack overflow")
        env = Environment(callee.env)
        for (name, _), value in zip(decl.params, args):
            env.define(name, value)
        self.frames.append(decl.name)
        try:
            self.execute_block(decl.body.stmts, env)
        except ReturnSignal as signal:
            return signal.value
        finally:
            self.frames.pop()
        return None

    def need(self, wanted, value, op):
        if type_name(value) != wanted:
            raise CometError(f"'{op}' needs {wanted}, not {type_name(value)}")

    def binary(self, expr):
        op = expr.op
        left = self.evaluate(expr.left)
        if op in ("and", "or"):
            self.need("bool", left, op)
            if (op == "and" and not left) or (op == "or" and left):
                return left
            right = self.evaluate(expr.right)
            self.need("bool", right, op)
            return right
        right = self.evaluate(expr.right)
        if op in ("==", "!="):
            if type_name(left) != type_name(right):
                raise CometError(f"cannot compare {type_name(left)} with {type_name(right)}")
            return (left is right if isinstance(left, Closure) else left == right) == (op == "==")
        if op == "+" and type_name(left) == "str" and type_name(right) == "str":
            return left + right
        self.need("int", left, op)
        self.need("int", right, op)
        if op == "+":
            return left + right
        if op == "-":
            return left - right
        if op == "*":
            return left * right
        if op == "/":
            return comet_div(left, right)
        if op == "%":
            return comet_mod(left, right)
        if op == "<":
            return left < right
        if op == "<=":
            return left <= right
        if op == ">":
            return left > right
        return left >= right


def run_source(source):
    interp = Interpreter()
    try:
        interp.run(parse_program(tokenize(source)))
    except CometError as e:
        return interp.output, str(e)
    return interp.output, None


class Resolver:
    def __init__(self):
        self.scopes = [set()]
        self.top_level = set()
        self.functions = 0
        self.errors = []

    def resolve(self, program):
        for stmt in program.stmts:
            if isinstance(stmt, (Let, Fn)):
                self.top_level.add(stmt.name)
        self.statements(program.stmts)
        return self.errors

    def declare(self, name):
        if name in self.scopes[-1]:
            self.errors.append(f"{name} is already declared in this scope")
        self.scopes[-1].add(name)

    def use(self, node, name, message):
        for i in range(len(self.scopes) - 1, 0, -1):
            if name in self.scopes[i]:
                node.depth = len(self.scopes) - 1 - i
                return
        node.depth = None
        if name in self.scopes[0]:
            return
        if self.functions > 0 and name in self.top_level:
            return
        self.errors.append(f"{message} {name}")

    def statements(self, stmts):
        for stmt in stmts:
            self.stmt(stmt)

    def block(self, stmts):
        self.scopes.append(set())
        self.statements(stmts)
        self.scopes.pop()

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, Let):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.declare(s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Assign):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.use(s, s.name, "assignment to undeclared variable")
        elif isinstance(s, (Print, ExprStmt)):
            self.expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            self.expr(s.cond)
            self.stmt(s.then)
            if s.else_ is not None:
                self.stmt(s.else_)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            self.expr(s.cond)
            self.stmt(s.body)
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            self.block(s.stmts)
        elif isinstance(s, Return):
            if self.functions == 0:
                self.errors.append("return outside a function")
            if s.expr is not None:
                self.expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, Fn):
            self.declare(s.name)
            self.function(s)

    def function(self, s):
        self.functions += 1
        self.scopes.append(set())
        for name, _ in s.params:
            self.declare(name)
        self.statements(s.body.stmts)
        self.scopes.pop()
        self.functions -= 1

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            self.use(e, e.name, "undefined variable")
        elif isinstance(e, Unary):
            self.expr(e.expr)
        elif isinstance(e, Binary):
            self.expr(e.left)
            self.expr(e.right)
        elif isinstance(e, Call):
            self.expr(e.callee)
            for arg in e.args:
                self.expr(arg)


class ResolvedInterpreter(Interpreter):
    """The lesson 8 interpreter, reading and assigning variables at the distances the resolver found."""

    def evaluate(self, expr):
        if isinstance(expr, Var):
            return self.at(expr).values[expr.name] if expr.depth is not None else self.globals.lookup(expr.name)
        return super().evaluate(expr)

    def execute(self, stmt):
        if isinstance(stmt, Assign):
            value = self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
            if stmt.depth is not None:
                self.at(stmt).values[stmt.name] = value
            else:
                self.globals.assign(stmt.name, value)
            return
        super().execute(stmt)

    def at(self, node):
        env = self.env
        for _ in range(node.depth):
            env = env.parent
        return env


def check(source):
    return Resolver().resolve(parse_program(tokenize(source)))


def run_resolved(source):
    program = parse_program(tokenize(source))
    errors = Resolver().resolve(program)
    if errors:
        return [], errors[0]
    interp = ResolvedInterpreter()
    try:
        interp.run(program)
    except CometError as e:
        return interp.output, str(e)
    return interp.output, None

from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"


@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int


class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col


def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col


COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")


class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())


def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()


class CometError(Exception):
    pass

    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)

def type_name(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "bool"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return "int"
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return "str"
    if isinstance(value, Closure):
        return "fn"

    return "nothing"


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    if isinstance(value, Closure):
        return f"<fn {value.decl.name}>"

    if value is None:
        raise CometError("cannot print nothing")
    return str(value)


class Environment:
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        self.values = {}
        self.parent = parent

    def define(self, name, value):
        if name in self.values:
            raise CometError(f"{name} is already declared in this scope")
        self.values[name] = value

    def find(self, name):
        env = self
        while env is not None:
            if name in env.values:
                return env
            env = env.parent
        return None

    def lookup(self, name):
        env = self.find(name)
        if env is None:
            raise CometError(f"undefined variable {name}")
        return env.values[name]

    def assign(self, name, value):
        env = self.find(name)
        if env is None:
            raise CometError(f"assignment to undeclared variable {name}")
        env.values[name] = value


class Interpreter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.globals = Environment()
        self.env = self.globals
        self.output = []
        self.frames = []


    def run(self, program):
        for stmt in program.stmts:
            self.execute(stmt)

    def execute_block(self, stmts, env):
        previous = self.env
        self.env = env
        try:
            for stmt in stmts:
                self.execute(stmt)
        finally:
            self.env = previous

    def execute(self, stmt):
        if isinstance(stmt, Let):
            self.env.define(stmt.name, self.evaluate(stmt.expr))
        elif isinstance(stmt, Assign):
            value = self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
            self.env.assign(stmt.name, value)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Print):
            self.output.append(show(self.evaluate(stmt.expr)))
        elif isinstance(stmt, ExprStmt):
            self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
        elif isinstance(stmt, If):
            if self.condition(stmt.cond):
                self.execute(stmt.then)
            elif stmt.else_ is not None:
                self.execute(stmt.else_)
        elif isinstance(stmt, While):
            while self.condition(stmt.cond):
                self.execute(stmt.body)
        elif isinstance(stmt, Block):
            self.execute_block(stmt.stmts, Environment(self.env))
        elif isinstance(stmt, Fn):
            self.env.define(stmt.name, Closure(stmt, self.env))
        elif isinstance(stmt, Return):
            if not self.frames:
                raise CometError("return outside a function")
            value = None if stmt.expr is None else self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
            raise ReturnSignal(value)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(stmt).__name__} is not supported yet")

    def condition(self, expr):
        value = self.evaluate(expr)
        if not isinstance(value, bool):
            raise CometError(f"condition must be bool, not {type_name(value)}")
        return value

    def evaluate(self, expr):
        if isinstance(expr, (Num, Str, Bool)):
            return expr.value
        if isinstance(expr, Var):
            return self.env.lookup(expr.name)
        if isinstance(expr, Unary):
            value = self.evaluate(expr.expr)
            if expr.op == "-":
                self.need("int", value, "-")
                return -value
            self.need("bool", value, "not")
            return not value
        if isinstance(expr, Binary):
            return self.binary(expr)
        if isinstance(expr, Call):
            callee = self.evaluate(expr.callee)
            args = [self.evaluate(arg) for arg in expr.args]
            return self.call(callee, args)
        raise CometError(f"{type(expr).__name__} is not supported yet")

    def call(self, callee, args):
        if not isinstance(callee, Closure):
            raise CometError(f"cannot call a value of type {type_name(callee)}")
        decl = callee.decl
        if len(args) != len(decl.params):
            raise CometError(f"{decl.name} expects {len(decl.params)} arguments, got {len(args)}")
        if len(self.frames) >= MAX_DEPTH:
            raise CometError("stack overflow")
        env = Environment(callee.env)
        for (name, _), value in zip(decl.params, args):
            env.define(name, value)
        self.frames.append(decl.name)
        try:
            self.execute_block(decl.body.stmts, env)
        except ReturnSignal as signal:
            return signal.value
        finally:
            self.frames.pop()
        return None

    def need(self, wanted, value, op):
        if type_name(value) != wanted:
            raise CometError(f"'{op}' needs {wanted}, not {type_name(value)}")

    def binary(self, expr):
        op = expr.op
        left = self.evaluate(expr.left)
        if op in ("and", "or"):
            self.need("bool", left, op)
            if (op == "and" and not left) or (op == "or" and left):
                return left
            right = self.evaluate(expr.right)
            self.need("bool", right, op)
            return right
        right = self.evaluate(expr.right)
        if op in ("==", "!="):
            if type_name(left) != type_name(right):
                raise CometError(f"cannot compare {type_name(left)} with {type_name(right)}")
            return (left is right if isinstance(left, Closure) else left == right) == (op == "==")
        if op == "+" and type_name(left) == "str" and type_name(right) == "str":
            return left + right
        self.need("int", left, op)
        self.need("int", right, op)
        if op == "+":
            return left + right
        if op == "-":
            return left - right
        if op == "*":
            return left * right
        if op == "/":
            return comet_div(left, right)
        if op == "%":
            return comet_mod(left, right)
        if op == "<":
            return left < right
        if op == "<=":
            return left <= right
        if op == ">":
            return left > right
        return left >= right


def run_source(source):
    interp = Interpreter()
    try:
        interp.run(parse_program(tokenize(source)))
    except CometError as e:
        return interp.output, str(e)
    return interp.output, None


class Resolver:
    def __init__(self):
        self.scopes = [set()]
        self.top_level = set()
        self.functions = 0
        self.errors = []

    def resolve(self, program):
        for stmt in program.stmts:
            if isinstance(stmt, (Let, Fn)):
                self.top_level.add(stmt.name)
        self.statements(program.stmts)
        return self.errors

    def declare(self, name):
        if name in self.scopes[-1]:
            self.errors.append(f"{name} is already declared in this scope")
        self.scopes[-1].add(name)

    def use(self, node, name, message):
        for i in range(len(self.scopes) - 1, 0, -1):
            if name in self.scopes[i]:
                node.depth = len(self.scopes) - 1 - i
                return
        node.depth = None
        if name in self.scopes[0]:
            return
        if self.functions > 0 and name in self.top_level:
            return
        self.errors.append(f"{message} {name}")

    def statements(self, stmts):
        for i, s in enumerate(stmts):
            if isinstance(s, Fn) and (i == 0 or not isinstance(stmts[i - 1], Fn)):
                j = i
                while j < len(stmts) and isinstance(stmts[j], Fn):
                    self.declare(stmts[j].name)
                    j += 1
            self.stmt(s)

    def block(self, stmts):
        self.scopes.append(set())
        self.statements(stmts)
        self.scopes.pop()

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, Let):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.declare(s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Assign):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.use(s, s.name, "assignment to undeclared variable")
        elif isinstance(s, (Print, ExprStmt)):
            self.expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            self.expr(s.cond)
            self.stmt(s.then)
            if s.else_ is not None:
                self.stmt(s.else_)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            self.expr(s.cond)
            self.stmt(s.body)
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            self.block(s.stmts)
        elif isinstance(s, Return):
            if self.functions == 0:
                self.errors.append("return outside a function")
            if s.expr is not None:
                self.expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, Fn):
            self.function(s)

    def function(self, s):
        self.functions += 1
        self.scopes.append(set())
        for name, _ in s.params:
            self.declare(name)
        self.statements(s.body.stmts)
        self.scopes.pop()
        self.functions -= 1

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            self.use(e, e.name, "undefined variable")
        elif isinstance(e, Unary):
            self.expr(e.expr)
        elif isinstance(e, Binary):
            self.expr(e.left)
            self.expr(e.right)
        elif isinstance(e, Call):
            self.expr(e.callee)
            for arg in e.args:
                self.expr(arg)


class ResolvedInterpreter(Interpreter):
    """The lesson 8 interpreter, reading and assigning variables at the distances the resolver found."""

    def evaluate(self, expr):
        if isinstance(expr, Var):
            return self.at(expr).values[expr.name] if expr.depth is not None else self.globals.lookup(expr.name)
        return super().evaluate(expr)

    def execute(self, stmt):
        if isinstance(stmt, Assign):
            value = self.evaluate(stmt.expr)
            if stmt.depth is not None:
                self.at(stmt).values[stmt.name] = value
            else:
                self.globals.assign(stmt.name, value)
            return
        super().execute(stmt)

    def at(self, node):
        env = self.env
        for _ in range(node.depth):
            env = env.parent
        return env


def check(source):
    return Resolver().resolve(parse_program(tokenize(source)))


def run_resolved(source):
    program = parse_program(tokenize(source))
    errors = Resolver().resolve(program)
    if errors:
        return [], errors[0]
    interp = ResolvedInterpreter()
    try:
        interp.run(program)
    except CometError as e:
        return interp.output, str(e)
    return interp.output, None
