from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())

def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()

    parser = Parser(tokens)
    tree = parser.expr()
    if parser.peek().kind != "EOF":
        raise parser.error("expected end of input")
    return tree


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q

    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)

def raise_tac(code, name):
    tree = {}

    def atom(a):
        if isinstance(a, bool):
            return Bool(a)
        if isinstance(a, int):
            return Num(a)
        return tree.get(a, Var(a))

    for ins in code:
        op = ins[0]
        if op in ("label", "jump", "iffalse"):
            raise CometError("raise_tac takes straight-line code only")
        if op == "print":
            continue
        if op == "copy":
            value = atom(ins[2])
        elif op == "neg":
            value = Unary("-", atom(ins[2]))
        elif op == "not":
            value = Unary("not", atom(ins[2]))
        else:
            value = Binary(op, atom(ins[2]), atom(ins[3]))
        tree[ins[1]] = value
    return atom(name)


def expr(source):
    return parse_expr(tokenize(source))
--- hint
Walk the code once, keeping a dictionary from each assigned name to its current tree. Turn each operand into a tree with a small helper: constants become `Bool` or `Num`, names are looked up in the dictionary, and unknown names become `Var`.
--- hint
Build the new tree from the operands **before** storing it under the destination, so `x = x + 1` uses the old tree of `x`. At the end, return the helper applied to `name`.
--- check test | The example: a shared value appears twice
raise_tac([('+', '%1', 'a', 1), ('copy', 'x', '%1'), ('*', '%2', 'x', 'x'), ('copy', 'y', '%2')], 'y') == expr("(a + 1) * (a + 1)")
--- check test | A lowered expression comes back as the same tree
raise_tac([('-', '%1', 'a', 3), ('neg', '%2', 'b'), ('*', '%3', '%1', '%2'), ('+', '%4', '%3', 'c'), ('copy', 'y', '%4')], 'y') == expr("(a - 3) * -b + c")
--- check test | Reassignment uses the old value on the right
raise_tac([('+', '%1', 'x', 1), ('copy', 'x', '%1'), ('*', '%2', 'x', 2), ('copy', 'x', '%2')], 'x') == expr("(x + 1) * 2")
--- check test | Booleans stay booleans
raise_tac([('copy', 'ok', True), ('<', '%1', 'n', 0), ('not', '%2', '%1'), ('==', 'r', '%2', 'ok')], 'r') == Binary("==", Unary("not", Binary("<", Var("n"), Num(0))), Bool(True))
?? True is an int in Python: check isinstance(a, bool) before isinstance(a, int).
--- check test | Unassigned names, constants, and print
(raise_tac([('print', 'q'), ('copy', 'z', 0)], 'q'), raise_tac([('copy', 'z', 0)], 'z'), raise_tac([], 'w')) == (Var("q"), Num(0), Var("w"))
--- check test | Control flow is refused
raise_tac([('copy', 'a', 1)], 'a') == Num(1) and all(raises(CometError, lambda c=c: raise_tac(c, 'a')) for c in [[('label', 'L1')], [('jump', 'L1')], [('iffalse', 'a', 'L1')]])

+++ practice | Blocks nothing can reach
--- task
Code that can never run wastes memory on a spacecraft computer, and it usually points at a bug. The starter gives the lesson's `lower`, `tac(source)` and `build_cfg(code)`. Write two functions.

- `unreachable(code)`: the sorted list of the indexes of the basic blocks that no path from block 0 reaches, following the CFG's edges. Empty code gives `[]`.
- `remove_unreachable(code)`: the code with the instructions of those blocks left out, the rest in their original order.

The CFG does not look at the values of conditions, so the exit block of `while true { }` still counts as reachable. For example, for `[('jump', 'L1'), ('print', 0), ('label', 'L1'), ('print', 1)]`, block 1 (`print 0`) is unreachable, and removing it leaves `[('jump', 'L1'), ('label', 'L1'), ('print', 1)]`.
--- starter
from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())

def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()



def parse_expr(tokens):
    parser = Parser(tokens)
    tree = parser.expr()
    if parser.peek().kind != "EOF":
        raise parser.error("expected end of input")
    return tree


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


TAC_OPS = {
    "+": lambda a, b: a + b,
    "-": lambda a, b: a - b,
    "*": lambda a, b: a * b,
    "/": comet_div,
    "%": comet_mod,
    "==": lambda a, b: a == b,
    "!=": lambda a, b: a != b,
    "<": lambda a, b: a < b,
    "<=": lambda a, b: a <= b,
    ">": lambda a, b: a > b,
    ">=": lambda a, b: a >= b,
}


def run_tac(code, limit=200000):
    labels = {ins[1]: i for i, ins in enumerate(code) if ins[0] == "label"}
    env = {}
    output = []

    def value(a):
        if isinstance(a, str):
            if a not in env:
                raise CometError(f"undefined variable {a}")
            return env[a]
        return a

    pc = 0
    steps = 0
    try:
        while pc < len(code):
            steps += 1
            if steps > limit:
                raise CometError("step limit reached")
            ins = code[pc]
            op = ins[0]
            pc += 1
            if op == "label":
                continue
            if op == "jump":
                pc = labels[ins[1]]
            elif op == "iffalse":
                if value(ins[1]) is False:
                    pc = labels[ins[2]]
            elif op == "print":
                output.append(show(value(ins[1])))
            elif op == "copy":
                env[ins[1]] = value(ins[2])
            elif op == "neg":
                env[ins[1]] = -value(ins[2])
            elif op == "not":
                env[ins[1]] = not value(ins[2])
            else:
                env[ins[1]] = TAC_OPS[op](value(ins[2]), value(ins[3]))
    except CometError as e:
        return output, str(e)
    return output, None


class Lowerer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.code = []
        self.temps = 0
        self.labels = 0

    def new_temp(self):
        self.temps += 1
        return f"%{self.temps}"

    def new_label(self):
        self.labels += 1
        return f"L{self.labels}"

    def emit(self, *ins):
        self.code.append(ins)

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, (Num, Bool)):
            return e.value
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            return e.name
        if isinstance(e, Unary):
            a = self.expr(e.expr)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("neg" if e.op == "-" else "not", t, a)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "and":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, end)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "or":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            right = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, right)
            self.emit("jump", end)
            self.emit("label", right)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary):
            a = self.expr(e.left)
            b = self.expr(e.right)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit(e.op, t, a, b)
            return t
        raise CometError(f"{type(e).__name__} is not part of the IR")

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, (Let, Assign)):
            self.emit("copy", s.name, self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, Print):
            self.emit("print", self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            self.expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            for inner in s.stmts:
                self.stmt(inner)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            if s.else_ is None:
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("label", end)
            else:
                other = self.new_label()
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, other)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("jump", end)
                self.emit("label", other)
                self.stmt(s.else_)
                self.emit("label", end)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            top = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("label", top)
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
            self.stmt(s.body)
            self.emit("jump", top)
            self.emit("label", end)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(s).__name__} is not part of the IR")


def lower(program):
    lowerer = Lowerer()
    for s in program.stmts:
        lowerer.stmt(s)
    return lowerer.code


def build_cfg(code):
    leaders = set()
    for i, ins in enumerate(code):
        if i == 0 or ins[0] == "label":
            leaders.add(i)
        if ins[0] in ("jump", "iffalse") and i + 1 < len(code):
            leaders.add(i + 1)
    starts = sorted(leaders)
    ends = starts[1:] + [len(code)]
    blocks = [code[s:e] for s, e in zip(starts, ends)]
    block_of = {b[0][1]: i for i, b in enumerate(blocks) if b[0][0] == "label"}
    succ = []
    for i, block in enumerate(blocks):
        last = block[-1]
        out = set()
        if last[0] == "jump":
            out.add(block_of[last[1]])
        else:
            if last[0] == "iffalse":
                out.add(block_of[last[2]])
            if i + 1 < len(blocks):
                out.add(i + 1)
        succ.append(sorted(out))
    return blocks, succ


def tac(source):
    return lower(parse_program(tokenize(source)))


def unreachable(code):
    return []


def remove_unreachable(code):
    return code

from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())

def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()



def parse_expr(tokens):
    parser = Parser(tokens)
    tree = parser.expr()
    if parser.peek().kind != "EOF":
        raise parser.error("expected end of input")
    return tree


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


TAC_OPS = {
    "+": lambda a, b: a + b,
    "-": lambda a, b: a - b,
    "*": lambda a, b: a * b,
    "/": comet_div,
    "%": comet_mod,
    "==": lambda a, b: a == b,
    "!=": lambda a, b: a != b,
    "<": lambda a, b: a < b,
    "<=": lambda a, b: a <= b,
    ">": lambda a, b: a > b,
    ">=": lambda a, b: a >= b,
}


def run_tac(code, limit=200000):
    labels = {ins[1]: i for i, ins in enumerate(code) if ins[0] == "label"}
    env = {}
    output = []

    def value(a):
        if isinstance(a, str):
            if a not in env:
                raise CometError(f"undefined variable {a}")
            return env[a]
        return a

    pc = 0
    steps = 0
    try:
        while pc < len(code):
            steps += 1
            if steps > limit:
                raise CometError("step limit reached")
            ins = code[pc]
            op = ins[0]
            pc += 1
            if op == "label":
                continue
            if op == "jump":
                pc = labels[ins[1]]
            elif op == "iffalse":
                if value(ins[1]) is False:
                    pc = labels[ins[2]]
            elif op == "print":
                output.append(show(value(ins[1])))
            elif op == "copy":
                env[ins[1]] = value(ins[2])
            elif op == "neg":
                env[ins[1]] = -value(ins[2])
            elif op == "not":
                env[ins[1]] = not value(ins[2])
            else:
                env[ins[1]] = TAC_OPS[op](value(ins[2]), value(ins[3]))
    except CometError as e:
        return output, str(e)
    return output, None


class Lowerer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.code = []
        self.temps = 0
        self.labels = 0

    def new_temp(self):
        self.temps += 1
        return f"%{self.temps}"

    def new_label(self):
        self.labels += 1
        return f"L{self.labels}"

    def emit(self, *ins):
        self.code.append(ins)

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, (Num, Bool)):
            return e.value
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            return e.name
        if isinstance(e, Unary):
            a = self.expr(e.expr)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("neg" if e.op == "-" else "not", t, a)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "and":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, end)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "or":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            right = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, right)
            self.emit("jump", end)
            self.emit("label", right)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary):
            a = self.expr(e.left)
            b = self.expr(e.right)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit(e.op, t, a, b)
            return t
        raise CometError(f"{type(e).__name__} is not part of the IR")

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, (Let, Assign)):
            self.emit("copy", s.name, self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, Print):
            self.emit("print", self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            self.expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            for inner in s.stmts:
                self.stmt(inner)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            if s.else_ is None:
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("label", end)
            else:
                other = self.new_label()
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, other)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("jump", end)
                self.emit("label", other)
                self.stmt(s.else_)
                self.emit("label", end)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            top = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("label", top)
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
            self.stmt(s.body)
            self.emit("jump", top)
            self.emit("label", end)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(s).__name__} is not part of the IR")


def lower(program):
    lowerer = Lowerer()
    for s in program.stmts:
        lowerer.stmt(s)
    return lowerer.code


def build_cfg(code):
    leaders = set()
    for i, ins in enumerate(code):
        if i == 0 or ins[0] == "label":
            leaders.add(i)
        if ins[0] in ("jump", "iffalse") and i + 1 < len(code):
            leaders.add(i + 1)
    starts = sorted(leaders)
    ends = starts[1:] + [len(code)]
    blocks = [code[s:e] for s, e in zip(starts, ends)]
    block_of = {b[0][1]: i for i, b in enumerate(blocks) if b[0][0] == "label"}
    succ = []
    for i, block in enumerate(blocks):
        last = block[-1]
        out = set()
        if last[0] == "jump":
            out.add(block_of[last[1]])
        else:
            if last[0] == "iffalse":
                out.add(block_of[last[2]])
            if i + 1 < len(blocks):
                out.add(i + 1)
        succ.append(sorted(out))
    return blocks, succ


def tac(source):
    return lower(parse_program(tokenize(source)))


def unreachable(code):
    blocks, succ = build_cfg(code)
    if not blocks:
        return []
    seen = {0}
    queue = [0]
    while queue:
        b = queue.pop(0)
        for nxt in succ[b]:
            if nxt not in seen:
                seen.add(nxt)
                queue.append(nxt)
    return [i for i in range(len(blocks)) if i not in seen]


def remove_unreachable(code):
    blocks, succ = build_cfg(code)
    dead = set(unreachable(code))
    out = []
    for i, block in enumerate(blocks):
        if i not in dead:
            out.extend(block)
    return out
--- hint
Call `build_cfg`, then run a breadth-first search from block 0 over `succ`, keeping a set of the blocks you have seen. The unreachable blocks are the rest.
--- hint
For `remove_unreachable`, go through the blocks in order and extend the result with every block that is not in the unreachable set.
--- check case | The example
(unreachable([('jump', 'L1'), ('print', 0), ('label', 'L1'), ('print', 1)]), remove_unreachable([('jump', 'L1'), ('print', 0), ('label', 'L1'), ('print', 1)]))
=> ([1], [('jump', 'L1'), ('label', 'L1'), ('print', 1)])
--- check case | Empty code, and code with every block reachable
(unreachable([]), remove_unreachable([]), unreachable(tac("let i = 0; while i < 3 { i = i + 1; } print i;")))
=> ([], [], [])
--- check case | A loop with no way out leaves the code after it unreachable
unreachable([('label', 'L1'), ('print', 1), ('jump', 'L1'), ('label', 'L2'), ('print', 2)])
=> [1]
--- check case | Dead blocks can reach each other and still be dead
unreachable([('jump', 'L3'), ('label', 'L1'), ('print', 1), ('jump', 'L2'), ('label', 'L2'), ('jump', 'L1'), ('label', 'L3'), ('print', 3)])
=> [1, 2]
--- check case | The CFG ignores constant conditions
unreachable(tac("while true { print 1; } print 2;"))
=> []
--- check test | Removing dead code does not change what a program prints
(lambda c: run_tac(remove_unreachable(c)) == run_tac(c) and len(remove_unreachable(c)) == len(c) - 2)(tac("let x = 4; if x > 2 { print x; } else { print 0; }") + [('jump', 'L99'), ('print', 7), ('copy', 'x', 1), ('label', 'L99'), ('print', 'x')])

+++ practice | Finding the loops
--- task
Optimisers spend their effort on loops, so the first thing they do with a CFG is find them. The starter gives the lesson's `lower`, `tac(source)` and `build_cfg(code)`. Write `back_edges(code)`: run a depth-first search from block 0, visiting each block's successors in increasing order, and return the sorted list of the edges `(i, j)` for which block j is still **open** when the edge is followed (entered, but not yet finished). Those are the back edges.

- Empty code gives `[]`.
- A block that jumps to itself gives the edge `(i, i)`.
- Blocks that block 0 cannot reach are never visited, so a loop among them gives no edge.
- An edge to a block that is already finished (for example where two branches of an `if` meet again) is not a back edge.

For example, the lowered countdown `let k = 2; while k > 0 { k = k - 1; }` has one back edge, `(2, 1)`: from the loop body to the loop test.
--- starter
from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

@dataclass

class Call:
    callee: object
    args: list

    cond: object
    then: object

@dataclass

@dataclass
class Program:
    stmts: list

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())

def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()



def parse_expr(tokens):
    parser = Parser(tokens)
    tree = parser.expr()
    if parser.peek().kind != "EOF":
        raise parser.error("expected end of input")
    return tree


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


TAC_OPS = {
    "+": lambda a, b: a + b,
    "-": lambda a, b: a - b,
    "*": lambda a, b: a * b,
    "/": comet_div,
    "%": comet_mod,
    "==": lambda a, b: a == b,
    "!=": lambda a, b: a != b,
    "<": lambda a, b: a < b,
    "<=": lambda a, b: a <= b,
    ">": lambda a, b: a > b,
    ">=": lambda a, b: a >= b,
}


def run_tac(code, limit=200000):
    labels = {ins[1]: i for i, ins in enumerate(code) if ins[0] == "label"}
    env = {}
    output = []

    def value(a):
        if isinstance(a, str):
            if a not in env:
                raise CometError(f"undefined variable {a}")
            return env[a]
        return a

    pc = 0
    steps = 0
    try:
        while pc < len(code):
            steps += 1
            if steps > limit:
                raise CometError("step limit reached")
            ins = code[pc]
            op = ins[0]
            pc += 1
            if op == "label":
                continue
            if op == "jump":
                pc = labels[ins[1]]
            elif op == "iffalse":
                if value(ins[1]) is False:
                    pc = labels[ins[2]]
            elif op == "print":
                output.append(show(value(ins[1])))
            elif op == "copy":
                env[ins[1]] = value(ins[2])
            elif op == "neg":
                env[ins[1]] = -value(ins[2])
            elif op == "not":
                env[ins[1]] = not value(ins[2])
            else:
                env[ins[1]] = TAC_OPS[op](value(ins[2]), value(ins[3]))
    except CometError as e:
        return output, str(e)
    return output, None


class Lowerer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.code = []
        self.temps = 0
        self.labels = 0

    def new_temp(self):
        self.temps += 1
        return f"%{self.temps}"

    def new_label(self):
        self.labels += 1
        return f"L{self.labels}"

    def emit(self, *ins):
        self.code.append(ins)

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, (Num, Bool)):
            return e.value
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            return e.name
        if isinstance(e, Unary):
            a = self.expr(e.expr)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("neg" if e.op == "-" else "not", t, a)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "and":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, end)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "or":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            right = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, right)
            self.emit("jump", end)
            self.emit("label", right)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary):
            a = self.expr(e.left)
            b = self.expr(e.right)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit(e.op, t, a, b)
            return t
        raise CometError(f"{type(e).__name__} is not part of the IR")

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, (Let, Assign)):
            self.emit("copy", s.name, self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, Print):
            self.emit("print", self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            self.expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            for inner in s.stmts:
                self.stmt(inner)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            if s.else_ is None:
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("label", end)
            else:
                other = self.new_label()
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, other)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("jump", end)
                self.emit("label", other)
                self.stmt(s.else_)
                self.emit("label", end)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            top = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("label", top)
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
            self.stmt(s.body)
            self.emit("jump", top)
            self.emit("label", end)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(s).__name__} is not part of the IR")


def lower(program):
    lowerer = Lowerer()
    for s in program.stmts:
        lowerer.stmt(s)
    return lowerer.code


def build_cfg(code):
    leaders = set()
    for i, ins in enumerate(code):
        if i == 0 or ins[0] == "label":
            leaders.add(i)
        if ins[0] in ("jump", "iffalse") and i + 1 < len(code):
            leaders.add(i + 1)
    starts = sorted(leaders)
    ends = starts[1:] + [len(code)]
    blocks = [code[s:e] for s, e in zip(starts, ends)]
    block_of = {b[0][1]: i for i, b in enumerate(blocks) if b[0][0] == "label"}
    succ = []
    for i, block in enumerate(blocks):
        last = block[-1]
        out = set()
        if last[0] == "jump":
            out.add(block_of[last[1]])
        else:
            if last[0] == "iffalse":
                out.add(block_of[last[2]])
            if i + 1 < len(blocks):
                out.add(i + 1)
        succ.append(sorted(out))
    return blocks, succ


def tac(source):
    return lower(parse_program(tokenize(source)))

from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens
