from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

@dataclass
class Num:
    value: int

@dataclass
class Str:
    value: str

@dataclass
class Bool:
    value: bool

@dataclass
class Var:
    name: str

@dataclass
class Unary:
    op: str
    expr: object

@dataclass
class Binary:
    op: str
    left: object
    right: object

@dataclass
class Call:
    callee: object
    args: list

@dataclass
class Let:
    name: str
    type: object
    expr: object

@dataclass
class Assign:
    name: str
    expr: object

@dataclass
class Print:
    expr: object

@dataclass
class If:
    cond: object
    then: object
    else_: object

@dataclass
class While:
    cond: object
    body: object

@dataclass
class Fn:
    name: str
    params: list
    ret: object
    body: object

@dataclass
class Return:
    expr: object

@dataclass
class ExprStmt:
    expr: object

@dataclass
class Block:
    stmts: list

@dataclass
class Program:
    stmts: list

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())

def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()



def parse_expr(tokens):
    parser = Parser(tokens)
    tree = parser.expr()
    if parser.peek().kind != "EOF":
        raise parser.error("expected end of input")
    return tree


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


def type_name(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "bool"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return "int"
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return "str"
    if value is None:
        return "nothing"
    return "fn"


class Environment:
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        self.values = {}
        self.parent = parent

    def define(self, name, value):
        self.values[name] = value

    def lookup(self, name):
        env = self
        while env is not None:
            if name in env.values:
                return env.values[name]
            env = env.parent
        raise CometError(f"undefined variable {name}")

    def assign(self, name, value):
        env = self
        while env is not None:
            if name in env.values:
                env.values[name] = value
                return
            env = env.parent
        raise CometError(f"assignment to undeclared variable {name}")


class FunctionCode:
    def __init__(self, name, params, code):
        self.name = name
        self.params = params
        self.code = code

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"FunctionCode({self.name!r}, {self.params!r}, {self.code!r})"

    def __eq__(self, other):
        return isinstance(other, FunctionCode) and (self.name, self.params, self.code) == (other.name, other.params, other.code)


class Closure:
    def __init__(self, decl, env):
        self.decl = decl
        self.env = env


class Frame:
    def __init__(self, code, pc, env, base):
        self.code = code
        self.pc = pc
        self.env = env
        self.base = base


class VM:
    def __init__(self):
        self.stack = []
        self.frames = []
        self.globals = Environment()
        self.output = []
        self.steps = 0

    def pop(self):
        return self.stack.pop()

    def need(self, wanted, value, op):
        if type_name(value) != wanted:
            raise CometError(f"'{op}' needs {wanted}, not {type_name(value)}")

    def run(self, code):
        pc = 0
        env = self.globals
        while True:
            if pc >= len(code):
                return
            ins = code[pc]
            op = ins[0]
            pc += 1
            self.steps += 1
            if op == "CONST":
                value = ins[1]
                if isinstance(value, FunctionCode):
                    value = Closure(value, env)
                self.stack.append(value)
            elif op == "LOAD":
                self.stack.append(env.lookup(ins[1]))
            elif op == "STORE":
                env.assign(ins[1], self.pop())
            elif op == "DEFINE":
                env.define(ins[1], self.pop())
            elif op in ("ADD", "SUB", "MUL", "DIV", "MOD", "LT", "LE", "GT", "GE", "EQ", "NE"):
                b = self.pop()
                a = self.pop()
                self.stack.append(self.binary(op, a, b))
            elif op == "NEG":
                a = self.pop()
                self.need("int", a, "-")
                self.stack.append(-a)
            elif op == "NOT":
                a = self.pop()
                self.need("bool", a, "not")
                self.stack.append(not a)
            elif op == "JUMP":
                pc = ins[1]
            elif op == "JUMP_IF_FALSE":
                cond = self.pop()
                self.need("bool", cond, "condition")
                if not cond:
                    pc = ins[1]
            elif op == "PRINT":
                value = self.pop()
                if value is None:
                    raise CometError("cannot print nothing")
                if isinstance(value, Closure):
                    self.output.append(f"<fn {value.decl.name}>")
                else:
                    self.output.append(show(value))
            elif op == "POP":
                self.pop()
            elif op == "CALL":
                argc = ins[1]
                args = self.stack[len(self.stack) - argc:]
                del self.stack[len(self.stack) - argc:]
                callee = self.pop()
                if not isinstance(callee, Closure):
                    raise CometError(f"cannot call a value of type {type_name(callee)}")
                fn = callee.decl
                if len(fn.params) != argc:
                    raise CometError(f"{fn.name} takes {len(fn.params)} arguments, not {argc}")
                self.frames.append(Frame(code, pc, env, len(self.stack)))
                env = Environment(callee.env)
                for name, value in zip(fn.params, args):
                    env.define(name, value)
                code = fn.code
                pc = 0
            elif op == "RET":
                if not self.frames:
                    raise CometError("return outside a function")
                value = self.pop()
                frame = self.frames.pop()
                del self.stack[frame.base:]
                self.stack.append(value)
                code, pc, env = frame.code, frame.pc, frame.env
            elif op == "HALT":
                return
            else:
                raise CometError(f"unknown instruction {op}")

    def binary(self, op, a, b):
        if op in ("EQ", "NE"):
            if type_name(a) != type_name(b):
                raise CometError(f"cannot compare {type_name(a)} with {type_name(b)}")
            return (a == b) == (op == "EQ")
        if op == "ADD" and type_name(a) == "str" and type_name(b) == "str":
            return a + b
        self.need("int", a, op)
        self.need("int", b, op)
        if op == "ADD":
            return a + b
        if op == "SUB":
            return a - b
        if op == "MUL":
            return a * b
        if op == "DIV":
            return comet_div(a, b)
        if op == "MOD":
            return comet_mod(a, b)
        if op == "LT":
            return a < b
        if op == "LE":
            return a <= b
        if op == "GT":
            return a > b
        return a >= b


class Renamer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.scopes = [{}]
        self.used = {}

    def declare(self, name):
        scope = self.scopes[-1]
        if name in scope:
            raise CometError(f"{name} is already declared in this scope")
        count = self.used.get(name, 0)
        self.used[name] = count + 1
        scope[name] = name if count == 0 else f"{name}.{count}"
        return scope[name]

    def resolve(self, name):
        for scope in reversed(self.scopes):
            if name in scope:
                return scope[name]
        return name

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            return Var(self.resolve(e.name))
        if isinstance(e, Unary):
            return Unary(e.op, self.expr(e.expr))
        if isinstance(e, Binary):
            return Binary(e.op, self.expr(e.left), self.expr(e.right))
        if isinstance(e, Call):
            return Call(self.expr(e.callee), [self.expr(a) for a in e.args])
        return e

    def block(self, b, params=()):
        self.scopes.append({})
        new_params = [(self.declare(p), t) for p, t in params]
        stmts = [self.stmt(s) for s in b.stmts]
        self.scopes.pop()
        return Block(stmts), new_params

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, Let):
            value = self.expr(s.expr)
            return Let(self.declare(s.name), s.type, value)
        if isinstance(s, Assign):
            return Assign(self.resolve(s.name), self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, Print):
            return Print(self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            return ExprStmt(self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, Return):
            return Return(None if s.expr is None else self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, If):
            then = self.block(s.then)[0]
            if isinstance(s.else_, If):
                other = self.stmt(s.else_)
            elif s.else_ is not None:
                other = self.block(s.else_)[0]
            else:
                other = None
            return If(self.expr(s.cond), then, other)
        if isinstance(s, While):
            return While(self.expr(s.cond), self.block(s.body)[0])
        if isinstance(s, Fn):
            name = self.declare(s.name)
            body, params = self.block(s.body, s.params)
            return Fn(name, params, s.ret, body)
        raise CometError(f"unknown statement {type(s).__name__}")


def rename_program(program):
    renamer = Renamer()
    return Program([renamer.stmt(s) for s in program.stmts])


OPCODES = {"+": "ADD", "-": "SUB", "*": "MUL", "/": "DIV", "%": "MOD",
           "==": "EQ", "!=": "NE", "<": "LT", "<=": "LE", ">": "GT", ">=": "GE"}


class Compiler:
    def __init__(self):
        self.code = []
        self.in_function = False

    def emit(self, *ins):
        self.code.append(ins)
        return len(self.code) - 1

    def patch(self, index):
        self.code[index] = (self.code[index][0], len(self.code))

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, (Num, Str, Bool)):
            self.emit("CONST", e.value)
        elif isinstance(e, Var):
            self.emit("LOAD", e.name)
        elif isinstance(e, Unary):
            self.expr(e.expr)
            self.emit("NEG" if e.op == "-" else "NOT")
        elif isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "and":
            self.expr(e.left)
            first = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.expr(e.right)
            second = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.emit("CONST", True)
            done = self.emit("JUMP", None)
            self.patch(first)
            self.patch(second)
            self.emit("CONST", False)
            self.patch(done)
        elif isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "or":
            self.expr(e.left)
            first = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.emit("CONST", True)
            done1 = self.emit("JUMP", None)
            self.patch(first)
            self.expr(e.right)
            second = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.emit("CONST", True)
            done2 = self.emit("JUMP", None)
            self.patch(second)
            self.emit("CONST", False)
            self.patch(done1)
            self.patch(done2)
        elif isinstance(e, Binary):
            self.expr(e.left)
            self.expr(e.right)
            self.emit(OPCODES[e.op])
        elif isinstance(e, Call):
            self.expr(e.callee)
            for a in e.args:
                self.expr(a)
            self.emit("CALL", len(e.args))
        else:
            raise CometError(f"cannot compile {type(e).__name__}")

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, Let):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("DEFINE", s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Assign):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("STORE", s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Print):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("PRINT")
        elif isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("POP")
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            for inner in s.stmts:
                self.stmt(inner)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            self.expr(s.cond)
            skip = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.stmt(s.then)
            if s.else_ is None:
                self.patch(skip)
            else:
                done = self.emit("JUMP", None)
                self.patch(skip)
                self.stmt(s.else_)
                self.patch(done)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            top = len(self.code)
            self.expr(s.cond)
            leave = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.stmt(s.body)
            self.emit("JUMP", top)
            self.patch(leave)
        elif isinstance(s, Fn):
            inner = type(self)()
            inner.in_function = True
            inner.stmt(s.body)
            inner.emit("CONST", None)
            inner.emit("RET")
            self.emit("CONST", FunctionCode(s.name, [p for p, _ in s.params], inner.code))
            self.emit("DEFINE", s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Return):
            if not self.in_function:
                raise CometError("return outside a function")
            if s.expr is None:
                self.emit("CONST", None)
            else:
                self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("RET")
        else:
            raise CometError(f"cannot compile {type(s).__name__}")


def compile_program(program):
    compiler = Compiler()
    for s in program.stmts:
        compiler.stmt(s)
    compiler.emit("HALT")
    return compiler.code


def compile_source(source):
    return compile_program(rename_program(parse_program(tokenize(source))))


def run_source(source):
    vm = VM()
    try:
        vm.run(compile_source(source))
    except CometError as e:
        return vm.output, str(e)
    return vm.output, None


SYMBOLS = {"ADD": "+", "SUB": "-", "MUL": "*", "DIV": "/", "MOD": "%", "EQ": "==",
           "NE": "!=", "LT": "<", "LE": "<=", "GT": ">", "GE": ">="}


def literal(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        escaped = value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"').replace("\n", "\\n")
        return '"' + escaped + '"'
    raise CometError("only numbers, strings and booleans can be written back")


def decompile(code):
    stack = []
    lines = []
    for ins in code:
        op = ins[0]
        if op == "CONST":
            stack.append(literal(ins[1]))
        elif op == "LOAD":
            stack.append(ins[1])
        elif op in SYMBOLS:
            b = stack.pop()
            a = stack.pop()
            stack.append(f"({a} {SYMBOLS[op]} {b})")
        elif op == "NEG":
            stack.append(f"(-{stack.pop()})")
        elif op == "NOT":
            stack.append(f"(not {stack.pop()})")
        elif op == "CALL":
            n = ins[1]
            args = stack[len(stack) - n:]
            del stack[len(stack) - n:]
            callee = stack.pop()
            stack.append(f"{callee}({', '.join(args)})")
        elif op == "DEFINE":
            lines.append(f"let {ins[1]} = {stack.pop()};")
        elif op == "STORE":
            lines.append(f"{ins[1]} = {stack.pop()};")
        elif op == "PRINT":
            lines.append(f"print {stack.pop()};")
        elif op == "POP":
            lines.append(f"{stack.pop()};")
        elif op == "HALT":
            break
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{op} cannot be decompiled")
    return lines
--- hint
This is lesson 15's VM with strings on the stack. A dictionary from instruction names to Comet operators handles all eleven binary instructions in one case.
--- hint
For a string constant, replace backslashes first, then quotes, then newlines, and wrap the result in double quotes. Test for `bool` before `int`.
--- check case | The example
decompile([('LOAD', 'a'), ('CONST', 1), ('ADD',), ('PRINT',)])
=> ["print (a + 1);"]
--- check case | Every kind of statement
decompile(compile_source("let x = (a + 1) * 2; x = not b; g(); print -x;"))
=> ["let x = ((a + 1) * 2);", "x = (not b);", "g();", "print (-x);"]
--- check case | Calls with arguments, and strings with escapes
decompile(compile_source('print f(x, "say \\"hi\\"\\n", true) - 3;'))
=> ['print (f(x, "say \\"hi\\"\\n", true) - 3);']
--- check test | Decompiling then compiling gives the same bytecode
all(compile_source("\n".join(decompile(compile_source(s)))) == compile_source(s) for s in ["let t = 1 - 2 - 3; print t % 4 <= 1 * -t;", 'print ("a" + "b" == "ab") != false;', "f(1)(2, g(3)); let k = h(); print not not true;"])
--- check test | Control flow is refused
raises(CometError, lambda: decompile(compile_source("if a { print 1; }"))) and raises(CometError, lambda: decompile([('CONST', 1), ('RET',)]))
--- check case | HALT ends it, and empty code gives no lines
(decompile([('CONST', 1), ('PRINT',), ('HALT',), ('JUMP', 0)]), decompile([]))
=> (["print 1;"], [])

+++ practice | A peephole optimiser for bytecode
--- task
The code generator emits simple patterns that a second, local pass can tidy, as lesson 14 did for three-address code. Write `peephole(code)` for top-level bytecode (constants that are `FunctionCode`s are left as they are). It works in **rounds** until a round changes nothing:

1. **Thread jumps.** Every `JUMP` or `JUMP_IF_FALSE` whose target is a `JUMP` is retargeted to where that chain of `JUMP`s finally leads (stop following if the chain comes back to an index already seen). A `JUMP` whose chain would lead back to itself is left alone.
2. **Mark removals**, scanning from left to right and skipping instructions already marked:
   - a `('JUMP', t)` at index t − 1 (a jump to the next instruction) is removed;
   - a `CONST` followed by a `POP` is removed with it; a `('CONST', True)` followed by a `JUMP_IF_FALSE` (which can never jump) is removed with it; a `('CONST', False)` followed by `('JUMP_IF_FALSE', t)` becomes one `('JUMP', t)`. None of these three applies when the second instruction is itself a jump target.
3. **Renumber.** Remove the marked instructions. Each jump target becomes the new index of the same instruction, or, if that instruction was removed, of the next instruction that was kept (or the new length of the code, if none).

For example, `peephole([('CONST', 1), ('POP',), ('JUMP', 3), ('CONST', 5), ('PRINT',)])` is `[('CONST', 5), ('PRINT',)]`. The result must behave exactly like the input; the starter's compiler and `run_source`-style helpers let the checks test that.
--- starter
from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())

def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()



def parse_expr(tokens):
    parser = Parser(tokens)
    tree = parser.expr()
    if parser.peek().kind != "EOF":
        raise parser.error("expected end of input")
    return tree


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


def type_name(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "bool"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return "int"
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return "str"
    if value is None:
        return "nothing"
    return "fn"


class Environment:
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        self.values = {}
        self.parent = parent

    def define(self, name, value):
        self.values[name] = value

    def lookup(self, name):
        env = self
        while env is not None:
            if name in env.values:
                return env.values[name]
            env = env.parent
        raise CometError(f"undefined variable {name}")

    def assign(self, name, value):
        env = self
        while env is not None:
            if name in env.values:
                env.values[name] = value
                return
            env = env.parent
        raise CometError(f"assignment to undeclared variable {name}")


class FunctionCode:
    def __init__(self, name, params, code):
        self.name = name
        self.params = params
        self.code = code

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"FunctionCode({self.name!r}, {self.params!r}, {self.code!r})"

    def __eq__(self, other):
        return isinstance(other, FunctionCode) and (self.name, self.params, self.code) == (other.name, other.params, other.code)


class Closure:
    def __init__(self, decl, env):
        self.decl = decl
        self.env = env


class Frame:
    def __init__(self, code, pc, env, base):
        self.code = code
        self.pc = pc
        self.env = env
        self.base = base


class VM:
    def __init__(self):
        self.stack = []
        self.frames = []
        self.globals = Environment()
        self.output = []
        self.steps = 0

    def pop(self):
        return self.stack.pop()

    def need(self, wanted, value, op):
        if type_name(value) != wanted:
            raise CometError(f"'{op}' needs {wanted}, not {type_name(value)}")

    def run(self, code):
        pc = 0
        env = self.globals
        while True:
            if pc >= len(code):
                return
            ins = code[pc]
            op = ins[0]
            pc += 1
            self.steps += 1
            if op == "CONST":
                value = ins[1]
                if isinstance(value, FunctionCode):
                    value = Closure(value, env)
                self.stack.append(value)
            elif op == "LOAD":
                self.stack.append(env.lookup(ins[1]))
            elif op == "STORE":
                env.assign(ins[1], self.pop())
            elif op == "DEFINE":
                env.define(ins[1], self.pop())
            elif op in ("ADD", "SUB", "MUL", "DIV", "MOD", "LT", "LE", "GT", "GE", "EQ", "NE"):
                b = self.pop()
                a = self.pop()
                self.stack.append(self.binary(op, a, b))
            elif op == "NEG":
                a = self.pop()
                self.need("int", a, "-")
                self.stack.append(-a)
            elif op == "NOT":
                a = self.pop()
                self.need("bool", a, "not")
                self.stack.append(not a)
            elif op == "JUMP":
                pc = ins[1]
            elif op == "JUMP_IF_FALSE":
                cond = self.pop()
                self.need("bool", cond, "condition")
                if not cond:
                    pc = ins[1]
            elif op == "PRINT":
                value = self.pop()
                if value is None:
                    raise CometError("cannot print nothing")
                if isinstance(value, Closure):
                    self.output.append(f"<fn {value.decl.name}>")
                else:
                    self.output.append(show(value))
            elif op == "POP":
                self.pop()
            elif op == "CALL":
                argc = ins[1]
                args = self.stack[len(self.stack) - argc:]
                del self.stack[len(self.stack) - argc:]
                callee = self.pop()
                if not isinstance(callee, Closure):
                    raise CometError(f"cannot call a value of type {type_name(callee)}")
                fn = callee.decl
                if len(fn.params) != argc:
                    raise CometError(f"{fn.name} takes {len(fn.params)} arguments, not {argc}")
                self.frames.append(Frame(code, pc, env, len(self.stack)))
                env = Environment(callee.env)
                for name, value in zip(fn.params, args):
                    env.define(name, value)
                code = fn.code
                pc = 0
            elif op == "RET":
                if not self.frames:
                    raise CometError("return outside a function")
                value = self.pop()
                frame = self.frames.pop()
                del self.stack[frame.base:]
                self.stack.append(value)
                code, pc, env = frame.code, frame.pc, frame.env
            elif op == "HALT":
                return
            else:
                raise CometError(f"unknown instruction {op}")

    def binary(self, op, a, b):
        if op in ("EQ", "NE"):
            if type_name(a) != type_name(b):
                raise CometError(f"cannot compare {type_name(a)} with {type_name(b)}")
            return (a == b) == (op == "EQ")
        if op == "ADD" and type_name(a) == "str" and type_name(b) == "str":
            return a + b
        self.need("int", a, op)
        self.need("int", b, op)
        if op == "ADD":
            return a + b
        if op == "SUB":
            return a - b
        if op == "MUL":
            return a * b
        if op == "DIV":
            return comet_div(a, b)
        if op == "MOD":
            return comet_mod(a, b)
        if op == "LT":
            return a < b
        if op == "LE":
            return a <= b
        if op == "GT":
            return a > b
        return a >= b


def run_code(code):
    vm = VM()
    try:
        vm.run(code)
    except CometError as e:
        return vm.output, str(e)
    return vm.output, None


class Renamer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.scopes = [{}]
        self.used = {}

    def declare(self, name):
        scope = self.scopes[-1]
        if name in scope:
            raise CometError(f"{name} is already declared in this scope")
        count = self.used.get(name, 0)
        self.used[name] = count + 1
        scope[name] = name if count == 0 else f"{name}.{count}"
        return scope[name]

    def resolve(self, name):
        for scope in reversed(self.scopes):
            if name in scope:
                return scope[name]
        return name

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            return Var(self.resolve(e.name))
        if isinstance(e, Unary):
            return Unary(e.op, self.expr(e.expr))
        if isinstance(e, Binary):
            return Binary(e.op, self.expr(e.left), self.expr(e.right))
        if isinstance(e, Call):
            return Call(self.expr(e.callee), [self.expr(a) for a in e.args])
        return e

    def block(self, b, params=()):
        self.scopes.append({})
        new_params = [(self.declare(p), t) for p, t in params]
        stmts = [self.stmt(s) for s in b.stmts]
        self.scopes.pop()
        return Block(stmts), new_params

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, Let):
            value = self.expr(s.expr)
            return Let(self.declare(s.name), s.type, value)
        if isinstance(s, Assign):
            return Assign(self.resolve(s.name), self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, Print):
            return Print(self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            return ExprStmt(self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, Return):
            return Return(None if s.expr is None else self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, If):
            then = self.block(s.then)[0]
            if isinstance(s.else_, If):
                other = self.stmt(s.else_)
            elif s.else_ is not None:
                other = self.block(s.else_)[0]
            else:
                other = None
            return If(self.expr(s.cond), then, other)
        if isinstance(s, While):
            return While(self.expr(s.cond), self.block(s.body)[0])
        if isinstance(s, Fn):
            name = self.declare(s.name)
            body, params = self.block(s.body, s.params)
            return Fn(name, params, s.ret, body)
        raise CometError(f"unknown statement {type(s).__name__}")


def rename_program(program):
    renamer = Renamer()
    return Program([renamer.stmt(s) for s in program.stmts])


OPCODES = {"+": "ADD", "-": "SUB", "*": "MUL", "/": "DIV", "%": "MOD",
           "==": "EQ", "!=": "NE", "<": "LT", "<=": "LE", ">": "GT", ">=": "GE"}


class Compiler:
    def __init__(self):
        self.code = []
        self.in_function = False

    def emit(self, *ins):
        self.code.append(ins)
        return len(self.code) - 1

    def patch(self, index):
        self.code[index] = (self.code[index][0], len(self.code))

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, (Num, Str, Bool)):
            self.emit("CONST", e.value)
        elif isinstance(e, Var):
            self.emit("LOAD", e.name)
        elif isinstance(e, Unary):
            self.expr(e.expr)
            self.emit("NEG" if e.op == "-" else "NOT")
        elif isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "and":
            self.expr(e.left)
            first = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.expr(e.right)
            second = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.emit("CONST", True)
            done = self.emit("JUMP", None)
            self.patch(first)
            self.patch(second)
            self.emit("CONST", False)
            self.patch(done)
        elif isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "or":
            self.expr(e.left)
            first = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.emit("CONST", True)
            done1 = self.emit("JUMP", None)
            self.patch(first)
            self.expr(e.right)
            second = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.emit("CONST", True)
            done2 = self.emit("JUMP", None)
            self.patch(second)
            self.emit("CONST", False)
            self.patch(done1)
            self.patch(done2)
        elif isinstance(e, Binary):
            self.expr(e.left)
            self.expr(e.right)
            self.emit(OPCODES[e.op])
        elif isinstance(e, Call):
            self.expr(e.callee)
            for a in e.args:
                self.expr(a)
            self.emit("CALL", len(e.args))
        else:
            raise CometError(f"cannot compile {type(e).__name__}")

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, Let):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("DEFINE", s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Assign):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("STORE", s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Print):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("PRINT")
        elif isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("POP")
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            for inner in s.stmts:
                self.stmt(inner)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            self.expr(s.cond)
            skip = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.stmt(s.then)
            if s.else_ is None:
                self.patch(skip)
            else:
                done = self.emit("JUMP", None)
                self.patch(skip)
                self.stmt(s.else_)
                self.patch(done)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            top = len(self.code)
            self.expr(s.cond)
            leave = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.stmt(s.body)
            self.emit("JUMP", top)
            self.patch(leave)
        elif isinstance(s, Fn):
            inner = type(self)()
            inner.in_function = True
            inner.stmt(s.body)
            inner.emit("CONST", None)
            inner.emit("RET")
            self.emit("CONST", FunctionCode(s.name, [p for p, _ in s.params], inner.code))
            self.emit("DEFINE", s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Return):
            if not self.in_function:
                raise CometError("return outside a function")
            if s.expr is None:
                self.emit("CONST", None)
            else:
                self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("RET")
        else:
            raise CometError(f"cannot compile {type(s).__name__}")


def compile_program(program):
    compiler = Compiler()
    for s in program.stmts:
        compiler.stmt(s)
    compiler.emit("HALT")
    return compiler.code


def compile_source(source):
    return compile_program(rename_program(parse_program(tokenize(source))))


def run_source(source):
    vm = VM()
    try:
        vm.run(compile_source(source))
    except CometError as e:
        return vm.output, str(e)
    return vm.output, None


def peephole(code):
    return list(code)
