from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

@dataclass
class Num:
    value: int

@dataclass
class Str:
    value: str

@dataclass
class Bool:
    value: bool

@dataclass
class Var:
    name: str

@dataclass
class Unary:
    op: str
    expr: object

@dataclass
class Binary:
    op: str
    left: object
    right: object

@dataclass
class Call:
    callee: object
    args: list

@dataclass
class Let:
    name: str
    type: object
    expr: object

@dataclass
class Assign:
    name: str
    expr: object

@dataclass
class Print:
    expr: object

@dataclass
class If:
    cond: object
    then: object
    else_: object

@dataclass
class While:
    cond: object
    body: object

@dataclass
class Fn:
    name: str
    params: list
    ret: object
    body: object

@dataclass
class Return:
    expr: object

@dataclass
class ExprStmt:
    expr: object

@dataclass
class Block:
    stmts: list

@dataclass
class Program:
    stmts: list

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())

def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()



def parse_expr(tokens):
    parser = Parser(tokens)
    tree = parser.expr()
    if parser.peek().kind != "EOF":
        raise parser.error("expected end of input")
    return tree


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


def type_name(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "bool"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return "int"
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return "str"
    if value is None:
        return "nothing"
    return "fn"


class Environment:
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        self.values = {}
        self.parent = parent

    def define(self, name, value):
        self.values[name] = value

    def lookup(self, name):
        env = self
        while env is not None:
            if name in env.values:
                return env.values[name]
            env = env.parent
        raise CometError(f"undefined variable {name}")

    def assign(self, name, value):
        env = self
        while env is not None:
            if name in env.values:
                env.values[name] = value
                return
            env = env.parent
        raise CometError(f"assignment to undeclared variable {name}")


class FunctionCode:
    def __init__(self, name, params, code):
        self.name = name
        self.params = params
        self.code = code

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"FunctionCode({self.name!r}, {self.params!r}, {self.code!r})"

    def __eq__(self, other):
        return isinstance(other, FunctionCode) and (self.name, self.params, self.code) == (other.name, other.params, other.code)


class Closure:
    def __init__(self, decl, env):
        self.decl = decl
        self.env = env


class Frame:
    def __init__(self, code, pc, env, base):
        self.code = code
        self.pc = pc
        self.env = env
        self.base = base


class VM:
    def __init__(self):
        self.stack = []
        self.frames = []
        self.globals = Environment()
        self.output = []
        self.steps = 0

    def pop(self):
        return self.stack.pop()

    def need(self, wanted, value, op):
        if type_name(value) != wanted:
            raise CometError(f"'{op}' needs {wanted}, not {type_name(value)}")

    def run(self, code):
        pc = 0
        env = self.globals
        while True:
            if pc >= len(code):
                return
            ins = code[pc]
            op = ins[0]
            pc += 1
            self.steps += 1
            if op == "CONST":
                value = ins[1]
                if isinstance(value, FunctionCode):
                    value = Closure(value, env)
                self.stack.append(value)
            elif op == "LOAD":
                self.stack.append(env.lookup(ins[1]))
            elif op == "STORE":
                env.assign(ins[1], self.pop())
            elif op == "DEFINE":
                env.define(ins[1], self.pop())
            elif op in ("ADD", "SUB", "MUL", "DIV", "MOD", "LT", "LE", "GT", "GE", "EQ", "NE"):
                b = self.pop()
                a = self.pop()
                self.stack.append(self.binary(op, a, b))
            elif op == "NEG":
                a = self.pop()
                self.need("int", a, "-")
                self.stack.append(-a)
            elif op == "NOT":
                a = self.pop()
                self.need("bool", a, "not")
                self.stack.append(not a)
            elif op == "JUMP":
                pc = ins[1]
            elif op == "JUMP_IF_FALSE":
                cond = self.pop()
                self.need("bool", cond, "condition")
                if not cond:
                    pc = ins[1]
            elif op == "PRINT":
                value = self.pop()
                if value is None:
                    raise CometError("cannot print nothing")
                if isinstance(value, Closure):
                    self.output.append(f"<fn {value.decl.name}>")
                else:
                    self.output.append(show(value))
            elif op == "POP":
                self.pop()
            elif op == "CALL":
                argc = ins[1]
                args = self.stack[len(self.stack) - argc:]
                del self.stack[len(self.stack) - argc:]
                callee = self.pop()
                if not isinstance(callee, Closure):
                    raise CometError(f"cannot call a value of type {type_name(callee)}")
                fn = callee.decl
                if len(fn.params) != argc:
                    raise CometError(f"{fn.name} takes {len(fn.params)} arguments, not {argc}")
                self.frames.append(Frame(code, pc, env, len(self.stack)))
                env = Environment(callee.env)
                for name, value in zip(fn.params, args):
                    env.define(name, value)
                code = fn.code
                pc = 0
            elif op == "RET":
                if not self.frames:
                    raise CometError("return outside a function")
                value = self.pop()
                frame = self.frames.pop()
                del self.stack[frame.base:]
                self.stack.append(value)
                code, pc, env = frame.code, frame.pc, frame.env
            elif op == "HALT":
                return
            else:
                raise CometError(f"unknown instruction {op}")

    def binary(self, op, a, b):
        if op in ("EQ", "NE"):
            if type_name(a) != type_name(b):
                raise CometError(f"cannot compare {type_name(a)} with {type_name(b)}")
            return (a == b) == (op == "EQ")
        if op == "ADD" and type_name(a) == "str" and type_name(b) == "str":
            return a + b
        self.need("int", a, op)
        self.need("int", b, op)
        if op == "ADD":
            return a + b
        if op == "SUB":
            return a - b
        if op == "MUL":
            return a * b
        if op == "DIV":
            return comet_div(a, b)
        if op == "MOD":
            return comet_mod(a, b)
        if op == "LT":
            return a < b
        if op == "LE":
            return a <= b
        if op == "GT":
            return a > b
        return a >= b


def run_code(code):
    vm = VM()
    try:
        vm.run(code)
    except CometError as e:
        return vm.output, str(e)
    return vm.output, None


class Renamer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.scopes = [{}]
        self.used = {}

    def declare(self, name):
        scope = self.scopes[-1]
        if name in scope:
            raise CometError(f"{name} is already declared in this scope")
        count = self.used.get(name, 0)
        self.used[name] = count + 1
        scope[name] = name if count == 0 else f"{name}.{count}"
        return scope[name]

    def resolve(self, name):
        for scope in reversed(self.scopes):
            if name in scope:
                return scope[name]
        return name

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            return Var(self.resolve(e.name))
        if isinstance(e, Unary):
            return Unary(e.op, self.expr(e.expr))
        if isinstance(e, Binary):
            return Binary(e.op, self.expr(e.left), self.expr(e.right))
        if isinstance(e, Call):
            return Call(self.expr(e.callee), [self.expr(a) for a in e.args])
        return e

    def block(self, b, params=()):
        self.scopes.append({})
        new_params = [(self.declare(p), t) for p, t in params]
        stmts = [self.stmt(s) for s in b.stmts]
        self.scopes.pop()
        return Block(stmts), new_params

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, Let):
            value = self.expr(s.expr)
            return Let(self.declare(s.name), s.type, value)
        if isinstance(s, Assign):
            return Assign(self.resolve(s.name), self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, Print):
            return Print(self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            return ExprStmt(self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, Return):
            return Return(None if s.expr is None else self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, If):
            then = self.block(s.then)[0]
            if isinstance(s.else_, If):
                other = self.stmt(s.else_)
            elif s.else_ is not None:
                other = self.block(s.else_)[0]
            else:
                other = None
            return If(self.expr(s.cond), then, other)
        if isinstance(s, While):
            return While(self.expr(s.cond), self.block(s.body)[0])
        if isinstance(s, Fn):
            name = self.declare(s.name)
            body, params = self.block(s.body, s.params)
            return Fn(name, params, s.ret, body)
        raise CometError(f"unknown statement {type(s).__name__}")


def rename_program(program):
    renamer = Renamer()
    return Program([renamer.stmt(s) for s in program.stmts])


OPCODES = {"+": "ADD", "-": "SUB", "*": "MUL", "/": "DIV", "%": "MOD",
           "==": "EQ", "!=": "NE", "<": "LT", "<=": "LE", ">": "GT", ">=": "GE"}


class Compiler:
    def __init__(self):
        self.code = []
        self.in_function = False

    def emit(self, *ins):
        self.code.append(ins)
        return len(self.code) - 1

    def patch(self, index):
        self.code[index] = (self.code[index][0], len(self.code))

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, (Num, Str, Bool)):
            self.emit("CONST", e.value)
        elif isinstance(e, Var):
            self.emit("LOAD", e.name)
        elif isinstance(e, Unary):
            self.expr(e.expr)
            self.emit("NEG" if e.op == "-" else "NOT")
        elif isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "and":
            self.expr(e.left)
            first = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.expr(e.right)
            second = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.emit("CONST", True)
            done = self.emit("JUMP", None)
            self.patch(first)
            self.patch(second)
            self.emit("CONST", False)
            self.patch(done)
        elif isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "or":
            self.expr(e.left)
            first = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.emit("CONST", True)
            done1 = self.emit("JUMP", None)
            self.patch(first)
            self.expr(e.right)
            second = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.emit("CONST", True)
            done2 = self.emit("JUMP", None)
            self.patch(second)
            self.emit("CONST", False)
            self.patch(done1)
            self.patch(done2)
        elif isinstance(e, Binary):
            self.expr(e.left)
            self.expr(e.right)
            self.emit(OPCODES[e.op])
        elif isinstance(e, Call):
            self.expr(e.callee)
            for a in e.args:
                self.expr(a)
            self.emit("CALL", len(e.args))
        else:
            raise CometError(f"cannot compile {type(e).__name__}")

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, Let):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("DEFINE", s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Assign):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("STORE", s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Print):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("PRINT")
        elif isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("POP")
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            for inner in s.stmts:
                self.stmt(inner)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            self.expr(s.cond)
            skip = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.stmt(s.then)
            if s.else_ is None:
                self.patch(skip)
            else:
                done = self.emit("JUMP", None)
                self.patch(skip)
                self.stmt(s.else_)
                self.patch(done)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            top = len(self.code)
            self.expr(s.cond)
            leave = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.stmt(s.body)
            self.emit("JUMP", top)
            self.patch(leave)
        elif isinstance(s, Fn):
            inner = type(self)()
            inner.in_function = True
            inner.stmt(s.body)
            inner.emit("CONST", None)
            inner.emit("RET")
            self.emit("CONST", FunctionCode(s.name, [p for p, _ in s.params], inner.code))
            self.emit("DEFINE", s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Return):
            if not self.in_function:
                raise CometError("return outside a function")
            if s.expr is None:
                self.emit("CONST", None)
            else:
                self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("RET")
        else:
            raise CometError(f"cannot compile {type(s).__name__}")


def compile_program(program):
    compiler = Compiler()
    for s in program.stmts:
        compiler.stmt(s)
    compiler.emit("HALT")
    return compiler.code


def compile_source(source):
    return compile_program(rename_program(parse_program(tokenize(source))))


def run_source(source):
    vm = VM()
    try:
        vm.run(compile_source(source))
    except CometError as e:
        return vm.output, str(e)
    return vm.output, None


def resolve(code, i, seen=None):
    seen = set()
    while 0 <= i < len(code) and code[i][0] == "JUMP" and i not in seen:
        seen.add(i)
        i = code[i][1]
    return i


def peephole(code):
    code = list(code)
    while True:
        targets = {ins[1] for ins in code if ins[0] in ("JUMP", "JUMP_IF_FALSE")}
        changed = False
        new = []
        for i, ins in enumerate(code):
            if ins[0] in ("JUMP", "JUMP_IF_FALSE"):
                t = resolve(code, ins[1])
                if t != ins[1] and not (ins[0] == "JUMP" and t == i):
                    new.append((ins[0], t))
                    changed = True
                    continue
            new.append(ins)
        code = new
        targets = {ins[1] for ins in code if ins[0] in ("JUMP", "JUMP_IF_FALSE")}
        keep = [True] * len(code)
        replace = {}
        for i, ins in enumerate(code):
            if not keep[i]:
                continue
            nxt = code[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(code) else None
            if ins[0] == "JUMP" and ins[1] == i + 1:
                keep[i] = False
            elif ins[0] == "CONST" and nxt is not None and i + 1 not in targets:
                if nxt[0] == "POP" or (nxt[0] == "JUMP_IF_FALSE" and ins[1] is True):
                    keep[i] = keep[i + 1] = False
                elif nxt[0] == "JUMP_IF_FALSE" and ins[1] is False:
                    keep[i + 1] = False
                    replace[i] = ("JUMP", nxt[1])
        if all(keep) and not replace:
            if not changed:
                return code
            continue
        new_index = []
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(code)):
            new_index.append(count)
            if keep[i]:
                count += 1
        new_index.append(count)
        out = []
        for i, ins in enumerate(code):
            if not keep[i]:
                continue
            ins = replace.get(i, ins)
            if ins[0] in ("JUMP", "JUMP_IF_FALSE"):
                ins = (ins[0], new_index[ins[1]])
            out.append(ins)
        code = out
--- hint
Write a helper that follows a chain of `JUMP`s from an index, with a set of indexes already visited. For step 3, build a list `new_index` of length `len(code) + 1`: walking the old indexes, `new_index[i]` is the number of kept instructions before i.
--- hint
A round changed something if step 1 retargeted a jump or step 2 marked anything. Loop until a round changes nothing, and remember to recompute the set of jump targets after threading.
--- check case | The example
peephole([('CONST', 1), ('POP',), ('JUMP', 3), ('CONST', 5), ('PRINT',)])
=> [('CONST', 5), ('PRINT',)]
--- check case | A chain of jumps is threaded, and a jump to the next instruction goes
peephole([('LOAD', 'c'), ('JUMP_IF_FALSE', 4), ('CONST', 1), ('PRINT',), ('JUMP', 6), ('PRINT',), ('JUMP', 7), ('CONST', 2), ('PRINT',)])
=> [('LOAD', 'c'), ('JUMP_IF_FALSE', 6), ('CONST', 1), ('PRINT',), ('JUMP', 6), ('PRINT',), ('CONST', 2), ('PRINT',)]
--- check case | Constant conditions
(peephole([('CONST', True), ('JUMP_IF_FALSE', 4), ('CONST', 1), ('PRINT',), ('HALT',)]), peephole([('CONST', False), ('JUMP_IF_FALSE', 4), ('CONST', 1), ('PRINT',), ('HALT',)]))
=> ([('CONST', 1), ('PRINT',), ('HALT',)], [('JUMP', 3), ('CONST', 1), ('PRINT',), ('HALT',)])
--- check case | A pair is kept when its second instruction is a jump target
peephole([('LOAD', 'c'), ('JUMP_IF_FALSE', 3), ('CONST', 1), ('POP',), ('HALT',)])
=> [('LOAD', 'c'), ('JUMP_IF_FALSE', 3), ('CONST', 1), ('POP',), ('HALT',)]
--- check case | An endless loop is left alone, and empty code
(peephole([('JUMP', 0)]), peephole([]))
=> ([('JUMP', 0)], [])
--- check test | Compiled programs behave the same and get no longer
all((lambda c: run_code(peephole(c)) == run_code(c) and len(peephole(c)) <= len(c))(compile_source(s)) for s in ["let i = 0; while true { if i > 3 { print i; } i = i + 1; if i == 6 { print 0 - i; } }", "while false { print 1; } if true { print 2; } else { print 3; } 7; print false or true;", "let x = 5; if x > 1 and x < 10 { print x; } else { if x == 0 { print 0; } }", "let n = 0; while n < 3 { n = n + 1; } true; print n;"][1:])
--- check test | while true loses its constant test
(lambda c: not any(ins[0] == "CONST" and ins[1] is True for ins in peephole(c)) and run_code(peephole(c)) == run_code(c) == (["1", "2"], "division by zero"))(compile_source("let i = 0; while true { i = i + 1; print i; if i == 2 { let stop = 1 / 0; } }"))

+++ practice | Conditions as jumps, without booleans
--- task
Inside an `if` or `while` test, `a and b` does not need to build a `true` or `false` value at all: its only job is to decide where control goes. Write `CondCompiler`, a subclass of the lesson's `Compiler` (given in the starter, which makes function bodies with the same class), with a method `jump_false(e)`. It emits code that falls through when e is true and jumps when e is false, and returns the list of indexes of the jumps whose targets are still to be patched to the "false" place:

- `and`: `jump_false(left) + jump_false(right)`.
- `or`: `to_right = jump_false(left)`, then emit `('JUMP', None)`, patch every hole in `to_right` to here, then `holes = jump_false(right)`, patch the `JUMP` to here, and return `holes`.
- Anything else: compile it with `self.expr(e)` and emit `('JUMP_IF_FALSE', None)`; return a list holding its index.

Then override `stmt` so that `If` and `While` use `jump_false` for their condition, patching all the returned holes where the lesson's patterns patch their single `JUMP_IF_FALSE`; every other statement uses the lesson's `stmt`. Because every operand still meets a `JUMP_IF_FALSE`, `if 1 and true { }` is still a runtime error, while `if false and 1 { }` is not. The starter gives `compile_cond(source)` and `run_both(source)`, which runs a program compiled both ways and returns `(output, error, steps)` for each.

For example, `compile_cond("if a and b { print 1; }")` is `[('LOAD', 'a'), ('JUMP_IF_FALSE', 6), ('LOAD', 'b'), ('JUMP_IF_FALSE', 6), ('CONST', 1), ('PRINT',), ('HALT',)]`.
--- starter
from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())

def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()



def parse_expr(tokens):
    parser = Parser(tokens)
    tree = parser.expr()
    if parser.peek().kind != "EOF":
        raise parser.error("expected end of input")
    return tree


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


def type_name(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "bool"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return "int"
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return "str"
    if value is None:
        return "nothing"
    return "fn"


class Environment:
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        self.values = {}
        self.parent = parent

    def define(self, name, value):
        self.values[name] = value

    def lookup(self, name):
        env = self
        while env is not None:
            if name in env.values:
                return env.values[name]
            env = env.parent
        raise CometError(f"undefined variable {name}")

    def assign(self, name, value):
        env = self
        while env is not None:
            if name in env.values:
                env.values[name] = value
                return
            env = env.parent
        raise CometError(f"assignment to undeclared variable {name}")


class FunctionCode:
    def __init__(self, name, params, code):
        self.name = name
        self.params = params
        self.code = code

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"FunctionCode({self.name!r}, {self.params!r}, {self.code!r})"

    def __eq__(self, other):
        return isinstance(other, FunctionCode) and (self.name, self.params, self.code) == (other.name, other.params, other.code)


class Closure:
    def __init__(self, decl, env):
        self.decl = decl
        self.env = env


class Frame:
    def __init__(self, code, pc, env, base):
        self.code = code
        self.pc = pc
        self.env = env
        self.base = base


class VM:
    def __init__(self):
        self.stack = []
        self.frames = []
        self.globals = Environment()
        self.output = []
        self.steps = 0

    def pop(self):
        return self.stack.pop()

    def need(self, wanted, value, op):
        if type_name(value) != wanted:
            raise CometError(f"'{op}' needs {wanted}, not {type_name(value)}")

    def run(self, code):
        pc = 0
        env = self.globals
        while True:
            if pc >= len(code):
                return
            ins = code[pc]
            op = ins[0]
            pc += 1
            self.steps += 1
            if op == "CONST":
                value = ins[1]
                if isinstance(value, FunctionCode):
                    value = Closure(value, env)
                self.stack.append(value)
            elif op == "LOAD":
                self.stack.append(env.lookup(ins[1]))
            elif op == "STORE":
                env.assign(ins[1], self.pop())
            elif op == "DEFINE":
                env.define(ins[1], self.pop())
            elif op in ("ADD", "SUB", "MUL", "DIV", "MOD", "LT", "LE", "GT", "GE", "EQ", "NE"):
                b = self.pop()
                a = self.pop()
                self.stack.append(self.binary(op, a, b))
            elif op == "NEG":
                a = self.pop()
                self.need("int", a, "-")
                self.stack.append(-a)
            elif op == "NOT":
                a = self.pop()
                self.need("bool", a, "not")
                self.stack.append(not a)
            elif op == "JUMP":
                pc = ins[1]
            elif op == "JUMP_IF_FALSE":
                cond = self.pop()
                self.need("bool", cond, "condition")
                if not cond:
                    pc = ins[1]
            elif op == "PRINT":
                value = self.pop()
                if value is None:
                    raise CometError("cannot print nothing")
                if isinstance(value, Closure):
                    self.output.append(f"<fn {value.decl.name}>")
                else:
                    self.output.append(show(value))
            elif op == "POP":
                self.pop()
            elif op == "CALL":
                argc = ins[1]
                args = self.stack[len(self.stack) - argc:]
                del self.stack[len(self.stack) - argc:]
                callee = self.pop()
                if not isinstance(callee, Closure):
                    raise CometError(f"cannot call a value of type {type_name(callee)}")
                fn = callee.decl
                if len(fn.params) != argc:
                    raise CometError(f"{fn.name} takes {len(fn.params)} arguments, not {argc}")
                self.frames.append(Frame(code, pc, env, len(self.stack)))
                env = Environment(callee.env)
                for name, value in zip(fn.params, args):
                    env.define(name, value)
                code = fn.code
                pc = 0
            elif op == "RET":
                if not self.frames:
                    raise CometError("return outside a function")
                value = self.pop()
                frame = self.frames.pop()
                del self.stack[frame.base:]
                self.stack.append(value)
                code, pc, env = frame.code, frame.pc, frame.env
            elif op == "HALT":
                return
            else:
                raise CometError(f"unknown instruction {op}")

    def binary(self, op, a, b):
        if op in ("EQ", "NE"):
            if type_name(a) != type_name(b):
                raise CometError(f"cannot compare {type_name(a)} with {type_name(b)}")
            return (a == b) == (op == "EQ")
        if op == "ADD" and type_name(a) == "str" and type_name(b) == "str":
            return a + b
        self.need("int", a, op)
        self.need("int", b, op)
        if op == "ADD":
            return a + b
        if op == "SUB":
            return a - b
        if op == "MUL":
            return a * b
        if op == "DIV":
            return comet_div(a, b)
        if op == "MOD":
            return comet_mod(a, b)
        if op == "LT":
            return a < b
        if op == "LE":
            return a <= b
        if op == "GT":
            return a > b
        return a >= b


class Renamer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.scopes = [{}]
        self.used = {}

    def declare(self, name):
        scope = self.scopes[-1]
        if name in scope:
            raise CometError(f"{name} is already declared in this scope")
        count = self.used.get(name, 0)
        self.used[name] = count + 1
        scope[name] = name if count == 0 else f"{name}.{count}"
        return scope[name]

    def resolve(self, name):
        for scope in reversed(self.scopes):
            if name in scope:
                return scope[name]
        return name

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            return Var(self.resolve(e.name))
        if isinstance(e, Unary):
            return Unary(e.op, self.expr(e.expr))
        if isinstance(e, Binary):
            return Binary(e.op, self.expr(e.left), self.expr(e.right))
        if isinstance(e, Call):
            return Call(self.expr(e.callee), [self.expr(a) for a in e.args])
        return e

    def block(self, b, params=()):
        self.scopes.append({})
        new_params = [(self.declare(p), t) for p, t in params]
        stmts = [self.stmt(s) for s in b.stmts]
        self.scopes.pop()
        return Block(stmts), new_params

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, Let):
            value = self.expr(s.expr)
            return Let(self.declare(s.name), s.type, value)
        if isinstance(s, Assign):
            return Assign(self.resolve(s.name), self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, Print):
            return Print(self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            return ExprStmt(self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, Return):
            return Return(None if s.expr is None else self.expr(s.expr))
        if isinstance(s, If):
            then = self.block(s.then)[0]
            if isinstance(s.else_, If):
                other = self.stmt(s.else_)
            elif s.else_ is not None:
                other = self.block(s.else_)[0]
            else:
                other = None
            return If(self.expr(s.cond), then, other)
        if isinstance(s, While):
            return While(self.expr(s.cond), self.block(s.body)[0])
        if isinstance(s, Fn):
            name = self.declare(s.name)
            body, params = self.block(s.body, s.params)
            return Fn(name, params, s.ret, body)
        raise CometError(f"unknown statement {type(s).__name__}")


def rename_program(program):
    renamer = Renamer()
    return Program([renamer.stmt(s) for s in program.stmts])


OPCODES = {"+": "ADD", "-": "SUB", "*": "MUL", "/": "DIV", "%": "MOD",
           "==": "EQ", "!=": "NE", "<": "LT", "<=": "LE", ">": "GT", ">=": "GE"}


class Compiler:
    def __init__(self):
        self.code = []
        self.in_function = False

    def emit(self, *ins):
        self.code.append(ins)
        return len(self.code) - 1

    def patch(self, index):
        self.code[index] = (self.code[index][0], len(self.code))

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, (Num, Str, Bool)):
            self.emit("CONST", e.value)
        elif isinstance(e, Var):
            self.emit("LOAD", e.name)
        elif isinstance(e, Unary):
            self.expr(e.expr)
            self.emit("NEG" if e.op == "-" else "NOT")
        elif isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "and":
            self.expr(e.left)
            first = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.expr(e.right)
            second = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.emit("CONST", True)
            done = self.emit("JUMP", None)
            self.patch(first)
            self.patch(second)
            self.emit("CONST", False)
            self.patch(done)
        elif isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "or":
            self.expr(e.left)
            first = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.emit("CONST", True)
            done1 = self.emit("JUMP", None)
            self.patch(first)
            self.expr(e.right)
            second = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.emit("CONST", True)
            done2 = self.emit("JUMP", None)
            self.patch(second)
            self.emit("CONST", False)
            self.patch(done1)
            self.patch(done2)
        elif isinstance(e, Binary):
            self.expr(e.left)
            self.expr(e.right)
            self.emit(OPCODES[e.op])
        elif isinstance(e, Call):
            self.expr(e.callee)
            for a in e.args:
                self.expr(a)
            self.emit("CALL", len(e.args))
        else:
            raise CometError(f"cannot compile {type(e).__name__}")

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, Let):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("DEFINE", s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Assign):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("STORE", s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Print):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("PRINT")
        elif isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("POP")
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            for inner in s.stmts:
                self.stmt(inner)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            self.expr(s.cond)
            skip = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.stmt(s.then)
            if s.else_ is None:
                self.patch(skip)
            else:
                done = self.emit("JUMP", None)
                self.patch(skip)
                self.stmt(s.else_)
                self.patch(done)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            top = len(self.code)
            self.expr(s.cond)
            leave = self.emit("JUMP_IF_FALSE", None)
            self.stmt(s.body)
            self.emit("JUMP", top)
            self.patch(leave)
        elif isinstance(s, Fn):
            inner = type(self)()
            inner.in_function = True
            inner.stmt(s.body)
            inner.emit("CONST", None)
            inner.emit("RET")
            self.emit("CONST", FunctionCode(s.name, [p for p, _ in s.params], inner.code))
            self.emit("DEFINE", s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Return):
            if not self.in_function:
                raise CometError("return outside a function")
            if s.expr is None:
                self.emit("CONST", None)
            else:
                self.expr(s.expr)
            self.emit("RET")
        else:
            raise CometError(f"cannot compile {type(s).__name__}")


def compile_program(program):
    compiler = Compiler()
    for s in program.stmts:
        compiler.stmt(s)
    compiler.emit("HALT")
    return compiler.code


def compile_source(source):
    return compile_program(rename_program(parse_program(tokenize(source))))


def run_source(source):
    vm = VM()
    try:
        vm.run(compile_source(source))
    except CometError as e:
        return vm.output, str(e)
    return vm.output, None


class CondCompiler(Compiler):
    def jump_false(self, e):
        raise CometError("jump_false is not written yet")


def compile_cond(source):
    compiler = CondCompiler()
    for s in rename_program(parse_program(tokenize(source))).stmts:
        compiler.stmt(s)
    compiler.emit("HALT")
    return compiler.code


def run_both(source):
    results = []
    for code in (compile_source(source), compile_cond(source)):
        vm = VM()
        try:
            vm.run(code)
            results.append((vm.output, None, vm.steps))
        except CometError as e:
            results.append((vm.output, str(e), vm.steps))
    return results

from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens
