--- check test | With enough registers nothing spills
all(None not in allocate(s, 6)[1].values() for s in ["let i = 0; let t = 0; while i < 10 { let sq = i * i; t = t + sq % 7; i = i + 1; } print t;", "let a = 1; let b = 2; let c = a + b; let d = a * c; if d > b { print d - c; } else { print a; }"])

+++ question | Which way liveness flows
--- ask
In the liveness equations, out[B] is the union of in[S] over the successors S of B. Why successors and not predecessors?
--- choice
Because the blocks are numbered in order, and successors have larger numbers.
--- choice correct
Because a value is live if it may be read in the future, and the future of the end of B is whatever block runs next.
--- choice
Because predecessors are not known until the CFG is complete.
--- choice
Because liveness is computed forwards, starting from the entry block.
--- why
Liveness is a backward analysis: uses later in the program make values live earlier. Lesson 14's constant propagation was a forward analysis, where facts flow from predecessors. Choosing the wrong direction is the classic dataflow bug.

+++ question | The step Kempe gives
--- ask
In simplify-and-select, a vertex v was removed when it had fewer than k neighbours in the remaining graph. Why is a colour always free for v in the select phase?
--- choice
Because the vertices are coloured in alphabetical order.
--- choice correct
When v is popped, the only coloured neighbours are those still in the graph when v was removed, fewer than k of them, so they use fewer than k colours.
--- choice
Because the interference graph of any program is planar.
--- choice
Because every vertex has fewer than k neighbours in the original graph.
--- why
Select pops in the reverse order of removal, so the neighbours coloured before v are exactly the neighbours that were removed after v, which were still present, and counted, when v was removed. Fewer than k neighbours block fewer than k colours.

+++ question | What colouring costs in the worst case
--- ask
Why do compilers use the simplify heuristic instead of finding the minimum number of registers for each function?
--- choice
Because the minimum is always the maximum number of live values, which is easy to compute.
--- choice correct
Because deciding whether a graph is k-colourable is NP-complete for k ≥ 3, and interference graphs can be any graph, so an exact answer could take exponential time.
--- choice
Because a register allocator cannot see the whole function.
--- choice
Because the heuristic always finds the minimum anyway.
--- why
Chaitin proved that every graph is the interference graph of some program, so register allocation inherits the hardness of graph colouring. The heuristic runs in near-linear time and is usually close to optimal. (Programs in SSA form are the happy exception: their graphs are chordal and colour optimally in linear time.)

+++ practice | What is live after each instruction
--- task
Write `live_after(block, live_out)` for one basic block of three-address code: return a list with one set per instruction, the names live **just after** that instruction. `live_out` holds the names live at the end of the block.

Walk backwards from `live_out`. An instruction that writes d (everything except `print`, `iffalse`, `label` and `jump`) removes d, then adds the `str` operands it reads; `print a` and `iffalse a, L` add a if it is a name; `label` and `jump` change nothing. Return new sets, one per instruction, in the block's order; an empty block gives `[]`.

For example, `live_after([('+', '%1', 'a', 'b'), ('*', '%2', '%1', 'a'), ('copy', 'x', '%2'), ('print', 'x')], [])` is `[{'%1', 'a'}, {'%2'}, {'x'}, set()]`.

--- solution
class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


def live_after(block, live_out):
    live = set(live_out)
    result = []
    for ins in reversed(block):
        result.append(set(live))
        if ins[0] in ("label", "jump"):
            continue
        if ins[0] in ("print", "iffalse"):
            uses = [ins[1]]
        else:
            live.discard(ins[1])
            uses = ins[2:]
        live |= {a for a in uses if isinstance(a, str)}
    result.reverse()
    return result
--- hint
Keep one set `live`, starting as a copy of `live_out`. Going through `reversed(block)`, first record a copy of `live` (that is the set after the instruction), then update `live` for the instruction.
--- hint
Reverse the recorded list at the end, so it is in the block's order.
--- check case | The example
live_after([('+', '%1', 'a', 'b'), ('*', '%2', '%1', 'a'), ('copy', 'x', '%2'), ('print', 'x')], [])
=> [{'%1', 'a'}, {'%2'}, {'x'}, set()]
--- check case | Live-out names stay live until written
live_after([('copy', 'n', 0), ('+', 't', 'n', 'k'), ('print', 't')], ['n', 'k'])
=> [{'n', 'k'}, {'t', 'n', 'k'}, {'n', 'k'}]
--- check case | x = x + 1 needs x before it, and labels change nothing
live_after([('label', 'L1'), ('+', 'x', 'x', 1), ('iffalse', 'ok', 'L1')], ['x'])
=> [{'x', 'ok'}, {'x', 'ok'}, {'x'}]
--- check case | Constants are not names; an empty block
(live_after([('copy', 'a', 5), ('print', 7)], []), live_after([], ['z']))
=> ([set(), set()], [])

+++ practice | Register pressure
--- task
The most names live at one point of a basic block is its **register pressure**: no allocation can use fewer registers there without spilling. For straight-line code it is also enough, because intervals of a line can always be coloured with as many colours as the largest number that overlap. Write `register_pressure(block, live_out)`, which returns the largest number of names live at any point of the block: before the first instruction, between two instructions, or after the last one (which is `len(live_out)`).

Use the lesson's backward walk: an instruction writing d removes d and then adds the names it reads; `print a` and `iffalse a, L` add a if it is a name; `label` and `jump` change nothing. For example, `register_pressure([('+', '%1', 'a', 'b'), ('*', '%2', '%1', 'a'), ('print', '%2')], [])` is 2.

--- solution
class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


def register_pressure(block, live_out):
    live = set(live_out)
    best = len(live)
    for ins in reversed(block):
        if ins[0] in ("print", "iffalse"):
            uses = [ins[1]]
        elif ins[0] in ("label", "jump"):
            uses = []
        else:
            live.discard(ins[1])
            uses = ins[2:]
        live |= {a for a in uses if isinstance(a, str)}
        best = max(best, len(live))
    return best
--- hint
Start with the size of `live_out` as the best so far. After updating the live set for each instruction, going backwards, compare its size with the best.
--- check case | The example
register_pressure([('+', '%1', 'a', 'b'), ('*', '%2', '%1', 'a'), ('print', '%2')], [])
=> 2
--- check case | Values computed early and used late raise the pressure
register_pressure([('copy', 'a', 1), ('copy', 'b', 2), ('copy', 'c', 3), ('+', 't', 'a', 'b'), ('+', 'u', 't', 'c'), ('print', 'u')], [])
=> 3
--- check case | The same values in a better order need fewer registers
register_pressure([('copy', 'a', 1), ('copy', 'b', 2), ('+', 't', 'a', 'b'), ('copy', 'c', 3), ('+', 'u', 't', 'c'), ('print', 'u')], [])
=> 2
--- check case | An empty block has the pressure of its live-out set
(register_pressure([], ['p', 'q']), register_pressure([], []))
=> (2, 0)
--- check case | Live-out names count everywhere they are live
register_pressure([('copy', 'x', 'y'), ('print', 'x')], ['x', 'y', 'z'])
=> 3

+++ practice | Selecting RISC-V instructions
--- task
Turn three-address code into RISC-V assembly, given a register for every name. Write `select(code, regs)`, where `regs` maps each name to a register name such as `"s1"`, and return the list of assembly lines. Registers `t0` and `t1` are scratch registers for constants: when an operand is a constant (an int, or a bool written as 1 or 0), first emit `li t0, c` for the first operand or `li t1, c` for the second, and use that register.

- `('label', L)` gives `"L:"`; `('jump', L)` gives `"j L"`; `('iffalse', a, L)` gives `"beqz A, L"`.
- `('copy', d, a)` gives `"mv D, A"`, or `"li D, c"` when a is a constant. `('neg', d, a)` gives `"sub D, zero, A"`; `('not', d, a)` gives `"xori D, A, 1"`.
- `+ - * / %` give `add`, `sub`, `mul`, `div`, `rem` as `"op D, A, B"`. RISC-V's `div` rounds toward zero like Comet, but dividing by zero does not trap, so before `div` or `rem` emit `"beqz B, div_by_zero"`.
- `<` gives `"slt D, A, B"`; `>` gives `"slt D, B, A"`; `<=` gives `"slt D, B, A"` then `"xori D, D, 1"`; `>=` gives `"slt D, A, B"` then `"xori D, D, 1"`; `==` gives `"sub D, A, B"` then `"seqz D, D"`; `!=` the same with `snez`.
- `('print', a)` gives `"mv a0, A"` (or `"li a0, c"`) then `"call print_int"`.

Here D, A and B are the registers of the destination and operands. For example, `select([('+', 'x', 'y', 3)], {'x': 's1', 'y': 's2'})` is `["li t1, 3", "add s1, s2, t1"]`.
--- starter
from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())

def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()



def parse_expr(tokens):
    parser = Parser(tokens)
    tree = parser.expr()
    if parser.peek().kind != "EOF":
        raise parser.error("expected end of input")
    return tree


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


TAC_OPS = {
    "+": lambda a, b: a + b,
    "-": lambda a, b: a - b,
    "*": lambda a, b: a * b,
    "/": comet_div,
    "%": comet_mod,
    "==": lambda a, b: a == b,
    "!=": lambda a, b: a != b,
    "<": lambda a, b: a < b,
    "<=": lambda a, b: a <= b,
    ">": lambda a, b: a > b,
    ">=": lambda a, b: a >= b,
}


def run_tac(code, limit=200000):
    labels = {ins[1]: i for i, ins in enumerate(code) if ins[0] == "label"}
    env = {}
    output = []

    def value(a):
        if isinstance(a, str):
            if a not in env:
                raise CometError(f"undefined variable {a}")
            return env[a]
        return a

    pc = 0
    steps = 0
    try:
        while pc < len(code):
            steps += 1
            if steps > limit:
                raise CometError("step limit reached")
            ins = code[pc]
            op = ins[0]
            pc += 1
            if op == "label":
                continue
            if op == "jump":
                pc = labels[ins[1]]
            elif op == "iffalse":
                if value(ins[1]) is False:
                    pc = labels[ins[2]]
            elif op == "print":
                output.append(show(value(ins[1])))
            elif op == "copy":
                env[ins[1]] = value(ins[2])
            elif op == "neg":
                env[ins[1]] = -value(ins[2])
            elif op == "not":
                env[ins[1]] = not value(ins[2])
            else:
                env[ins[1]] = TAC_OPS[op](value(ins[2]), value(ins[3]))
    except CometError as e:
        return output, str(e)
    return output, None


class Lowerer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.code = []
        self.temps = 0
        self.labels = 0

    def new_temp(self):
        self.temps += 1
        return f"%{self.temps}"

    def new_label(self):
        self.labels += 1
        return f"L{self.labels}"

    def emit(self, *ins):
        self.code.append(ins)

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, (Num, Bool)):
            return e.value
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            return e.name
        if isinstance(e, Unary):
            a = self.expr(e.expr)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("neg" if e.op == "-" else "not", t, a)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "and":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, end)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "or":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            right = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, right)
            self.emit("jump", end)
            self.emit("label", right)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary):
            a = self.expr(e.left)
            b = self.expr(e.right)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit(e.op, t, a, b)
            return t
        raise CometError(f"{type(e).__name__} is not part of the IR")

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, (Let, Assign)):
            self.emit("copy", s.name, self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, Print):
            self.emit("print", self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            self.expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            for inner in s.stmts:
                self.stmt(inner)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            if s.else_ is None:
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("label", end)
            else:
                other = self.new_label()
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, other)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("jump", end)
                self.emit("label", other)
                self.stmt(s.else_)
                self.emit("label", end)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            top = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("label", top)
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
            self.stmt(s.body)
            self.emit("jump", top)
            self.emit("label", end)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(s).__name__} is not part of the IR")


def lower(program):
    lowerer = Lowerer()
    for s in program.stmts:
        lowerer.stmt(s)
    return lowerer.code


def build_cfg(code):
    leaders = set()
    for i, ins in enumerate(code):
        if i == 0 or ins[0] == "label":
            leaders.add(i)
        if ins[0] in ("jump", "iffalse") and i + 1 < len(code):
            leaders.add(i + 1)
    starts = sorted(leaders)
    ends = starts[1:] + [len(code)]
    blocks = [code[s:e] for s, e in zip(starts, ends)]
    block_of = {b[0][1]: i for i, b in enumerate(blocks) if b[0][0] == "label"}
    succ = []
    for i, block in enumerate(blocks):
        last = block[-1]
        out = set()
        if last[0] == "jump":
            out.add(block_of[last[1]])
        else:
            if last[0] == "iffalse":
                out.add(block_of[last[2]])
            if i + 1 < len(blocks):
                out.add(i + 1)
        succ.append(sorted(out))
    return blocks, succ

    return lower(parse_program(tokenize(source)))

    return []

from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())

def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()



def parse_expr(tokens):
    parser = Parser(tokens)
    tree = parser.expr()
    if parser.peek().kind != "EOF":
        raise parser.error("expected end of input")
    return tree


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


TAC_OPS = {
    "+": lambda a, b: a + b,
    "-": lambda a, b: a - b,
    "*": lambda a, b: a * b,
    "/": comet_div,
    "%": comet_mod,
    "==": lambda a, b: a == b,
    "!=": lambda a, b: a != b,
    "<": lambda a, b: a < b,
    "<=": lambda a, b: a <= b,
    ">": lambda a, b: a > b,
    ">=": lambda a, b: a >= b,
}


def run_tac(code, limit=200000):
    labels = {ins[1]: i for i, ins in enumerate(code) if ins[0] == "label"}
    env = {}
    output = []

    def value(a):
        if isinstance(a, str):
            if a not in env:
                raise CometError(f"undefined variable {a}")
            return env[a]
        return a

    pc = 0
    steps = 0
    try:
        while pc < len(code):
            steps += 1
            if steps > limit:
                raise CometError("step limit reached")
            ins = code[pc]
            op = ins[0]
            pc += 1
            if op == "label":
                continue
            if op == "jump":
                pc = labels[ins[1]]
            elif op == "iffalse":
                if value(ins[1]) is False:
                    pc = labels[ins[2]]
            elif op == "print":
                output.append(show(value(ins[1])))
            elif op == "copy":
                env[ins[1]] = value(ins[2])
            elif op == "neg":
                env[ins[1]] = -value(ins[2])
            elif op == "not":
                env[ins[1]] = not value(ins[2])
            else:
                env[ins[1]] = TAC_OPS[op](value(ins[2]), value(ins[3]))
    except CometError as e:
        return output, str(e)
    return output, None


class Lowerer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.code = []
        self.temps = 0
        self.labels = 0

    def new_temp(self):
        self.temps += 1
        return f"%{self.temps}"

    def new_label(self):
        self.labels += 1
        return f"L{self.labels}"

    def emit(self, *ins):
        self.code.append(ins)

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, (Num, Bool)):
            return e.value
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            return e.name
        if isinstance(e, Unary):
            a = self.expr(e.expr)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("neg" if e.op == "-" else "not", t, a)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "and":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, end)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "or":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            right = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, right)
            self.emit("jump", end)
            self.emit("label", right)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary):
            a = self.expr(e.left)
            b = self.expr(e.right)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit(e.op, t, a, b)
            return t
        raise CometError(f"{type(e).__name__} is not part of the IR")

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, (Let, Assign)):
            self.emit("copy", s.name, self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, Print):
            self.emit("print", self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            self.expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            for inner in s.stmts:
                self.stmt(inner)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            if s.else_ is None:
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("label", end)
            else:
                other = self.new_label()
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, other)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("jump", end)
                self.emit("label", other)
                self.stmt(s.else_)
                self.emit("label", end)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            top = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("label", top)
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
            self.stmt(s.body)
            self.emit("jump", top)
            self.emit("label", end)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(s).__name__} is not part of the IR")


def lower(program):
    lowerer = Lowerer()
    for s in program.stmts:
        lowerer.stmt(s)
    return lowerer.code


def build_cfg(code):
    leaders = set()
    for i, ins in enumerate(code):
        if i == 0 or ins[0] == "label":
            leaders.add(i)
        if ins[0] in ("jump", "iffalse") and i + 1 < len(code):
            leaders.add(i + 1)
    starts = sorted(leaders)
    ends = starts[1:] + [len(code)]
    blocks = [code[s:e] for s, e in zip(starts, ends)]
    block_of = {b[0][1]: i for i, b in enumerate(blocks) if b[0][0] == "label"}
    succ = []
    for i, block in enumerate(blocks):
        last = block[-1]
        out = set()
        if last[0] == "jump":
            out.add(block_of[last[1]])
        else:
            if last[0] == "iffalse":
                out.add(block_of[last[2]])
            if i + 1 < len(blocks):
                out.add(i + 1)
        succ.append(sorted(out))
    return blocks, succ


def tac(source):
    return lower(parse_program(tokenize(source)))


ARITH = {"+": "add", "-": "sub", "*": "mul", "/": "div", "%": "rem"}


def select(code, regs):
    lines = []

    def reg(a, scratch):
        if isinstance(a, str):
            return regs[a]
        lines.append(f"li {scratch}, {int(a)}")
        return scratch

    for ins in code:
        op = ins[0]
        if op == "label":
            lines.append(f"{ins[1]}:")
        elif op == "jump":
            lines.append(f"j {ins[1]}")
        elif op == "iffalse":
            lines.append(f"beqz {reg(ins[1], 't0')}, {ins[2]}")
        elif op == "print":
            a = ins[1]
            if isinstance(a, str):
                lines.append(f"mv a0, {regs[a]}")
            else:
                lines.append(f"li a0, {int(a)}")
            lines.append("call print_int")
        elif op == "copy":
            a = ins[2]
            if isinstance(a, str):
                lines.append(f"mv {regs[ins[1]]}, {regs[a]}")
            else:
                lines.append(f"li {regs[ins[1]]}, {int(a)}")
        elif op == "neg":
            lines.append(f"sub {regs[ins[1]]}, zero, {reg(ins[2], 't0')}")
        elif op == "not":
            lines.append(f"xori {regs[ins[1]]}, {reg(ins[2], 't0')}, 1")
        else:
            d = regs[ins[1]]
            a = reg(ins[2], "t0")
            b = reg(ins[3], "t1")
            if op in ARITH:
                if op in ("/", "%"):
                    lines.append(f"beqz {b}, div_by_zero")
                lines.append(f"{ARITH[op]} {d}, {a}, {b}")
            elif op == "<":
                lines.append(f"slt {d}, {a}, {b}")
            elif op == ">":
                lines.append(f"slt {d}, {b}, {a}")
            elif op == "<=":
                lines.append(f"slt {d}, {b}, {a}")
                lines.append(f"xori {d}, {d}, 1")
            elif op == ">=":
                lines.append(f"slt {d}, {a}, {b}")
                lines.append(f"xori {d}, {d}, 1")
            else:
                lines.append(f"sub {d}, {a}, {b}")
                lines.append(f"{'seqz' if op == '==' else 'snez'} {d}, {d}")
    return lines
--- hint
Write a helper `reg(a, scratch)`: for a name, return `regs[a]`; for a constant, append `li scratch, int(a)` and return the scratch register. `int(True)` is 1 and `int(False)` is 0.
--- hint
For a binary instruction, get the operands' registers first, in order (first with `t0`, second with `t1`), then emit the instruction or instructions for the operator.
--- check case | The example
select([('+', 'x', 'y', 3)], {'x': 's1', 'y': 's2'})
=> ["li t1, 3", "add s1, s2, t1"]
--- check case | A lowered program with a division and a comparison
select(tac("let a = 7; let b = a / 2; if a >= b { print b; } else { print -a; }"), {'a': 's1', 'b': 's2', '%1': 't2', '%2': 't3', '%3': 't4'})
=> ["li s1, 7", "li t1, 2", "beqz t1, div_by_zero", "div t2, s1, t1", "mv s2, t2", "slt t3, s1, s2", "xori t3, t3, 1", "beqz t3, L1", "mv a0, s2", "call print_int", "j L2", "L1:", "sub t4, zero, s1", "mv a0, t4", "call print_int", "L2:"]
--- check case | Equality, greater-than and not

+++ practice | Rewriting code around spilled names
--- task
When the colouring spills a name, the compiler keeps it in memory and rewrites the code so that the name is never needed in a register for long. Write `insert_spills(block, spilled)`, where `spilled` is a set of names, returning new code with two new instructions: `('load', t, v)` (read memory slot v into t) and `('store', v, t)` (write t into slot v).

- For each instruction, every operand it reads that is spilled is replaced by a fresh temporary, and a `load` into that temporary is emitted just before the instruction. If the same spilled name is read twice by one instruction (`x * x`), load it once and use the temporary for both.
- If the instruction writes a spilled name d, it writes a fresh temporary instead, and a `('store', d, t)` is emitted just after it.
- Loads come first, in operand order; then the instruction; then the store. For `x = x + 1` with x spilled, that is a load into one temporary and a store from another.
- Fresh temporaries are `"%s1"`, `"%s2"`, …, numbered in the order they are made, starting again for each call. `label` and `jump` pass through; the label of an `iffalse` is not a name.

For example, `insert_spills([('+', 'x', 'x', 'x'), ('print', 'y')], {'x'})` is `[('load', '%s1', 'x'), ('+', '%s2', '%s1', '%s1'), ('store', 'x', '%s2'), ('print', 'y')]`.
--- starter

        raise CometError("division by zero")

    return list(block)
--- solution
class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


def insert_spills(block, spilled):
    out = []
    count = 0

    def fresh():
        nonlocal count
        count += 1
        return f"%s{count}"

    for ins in block:
        op = ins[0]
        if op in ("label", "jump"):
            out.append(ins)
            continue
        if op == "print":
            dst, operands = None, [ins[1]]
        elif op == "iffalse":
            dst, operands = None, [ins[1]]
        else:
            dst, operands = ins[1], list(ins[2:])
        loaded = {}
        args = []
        for a in operands:
            if isinstance(a, str) and a in spilled:
                if a not in loaded:
                    loaded[a] = fresh()
                    out.append(("load", loaded[a], a))
                args.append(loaded[a])
            else:
                args.append(a)
        if op == "print":
            out.append(("print", args[0]))
        elif op == "iffalse":
            out.append(("iffalse", args[0], ins[2]))
        elif dst in spilled:
            t = fresh()
            out.append((op, t, *args))
            out.append(("store", dst, t))
        else:
            out.append((op, dst, *args))
    return out
--- hint
For each instruction, work out which of its fields are operands it reads (for `print` and `iffalse` only the first operand; for others everything after the destination). Keep a small dictionary from spilled name to its temporary for the current instruction.
--- hint
Make the destination's temporary after the operands' temporaries, so the numbers come out in the order the task describes.
--- check case | The example
insert_spills([('+', 'x', 'x', 'x'), ('print', 'y')], {'x'})
=> [('load', '%s1', 'x'), ('+', '%s2', '%s1', '%s1'), ('store', 'x', '%s2'), ('print', 'y')]
--- check case | No spills leaves the code unchanged, and empty code
(insert_spills([('copy', 'a', 1), ('print', 'a')], set()), insert_spills([], {'a'}))
=> ([('copy', 'a', 1), ('print', 'a')], [])
--- check case | print, iffalse, labels and jumps
insert_spills([('label', 'L1'), ('print', 'x'), ('iffalse', 'x', 'L1'), ('jump', 'L1')], {'x', 'L1'})
=> [('label', 'L1'), ('load', '%s1', 'x'), ('print', '%s1'), ('load', '%s2', 'x'), ('iffalse', '%s2', 'L1'), ('jump', 'L1')]
--- check case | Two spilled operands, in order, and constants untouched
insert_spills([('-', 'd', 'b', 'a'), ('neg', 'e', 'a'), ('*', 'f', 3, 'b')], {'a', 'b', 'e'})
=> [('load', '%s1', 'b'), ('load', '%s2', 'a'), ('-', 'd', '%s1', '%s2'), ('load', '%s3', 'a'), ('neg', '%s4', '%s3'), ('store', 'e', '%s4'), ('load', '%s5', 'b'), ('*', 'f', 3, '%s5')]
--- check case | A copy into and out of a spilled name
insert_spills([('copy', 'x', 'y'), ('copy', 'z', 'x')], {'x'})
=> [('copy', '%s1', 'y'), ('store', 'x', '%s1'), ('load', '%s2', 'x'), ('copy', 'z', '%s2')]

+++ practice | Debug: liveness that forgets the loop
--- task
This `liveness(blocks, succ)` should return the least solution of the liveness equations, `(live_in, live_out)` with one set per block. On straight-line code and on `if` statements it is right, but on loops it misses names: for the lowered `let k = 2; let s = 0; while k > 0 { s = s + k; k = k - 1; } print s;` it says that `k` is not live at the end of the loop body, although the loop test reads it next. Find the bug and fix it.
--- starter
from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())

def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()



def parse_expr(tokens):
    parser = Parser(tokens)
    tree = parser.expr()
    if parser.peek().kind != "EOF":
        raise parser.error("expected end of input")
    return tree


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


TAC_OPS = {
    "+": lambda a, b: a + b,
    "-": lambda a, b: a - b,
    "*": lambda a, b: a * b,
    "/": comet_div,
    "%": comet_mod,
    "==": lambda a, b: a == b,
    "!=": lambda a, b: a != b,
    "<": lambda a, b: a < b,
    "<=": lambda a, b: a <= b,
    ">": lambda a, b: a > b,
    ">=": lambda a, b: a >= b,
}


def run_tac(code, limit=200000):
    labels = {ins[1]: i for i, ins in enumerate(code) if ins[0] == "label"}
    env = {}
    output = []

    def value(a):
        if isinstance(a, str):
            if a not in env:
                raise CometError(f"undefined variable {a}")
            return env[a]
        return a

    pc = 0
    steps = 0
    try:
        while pc < len(code):
            steps += 1
            if steps > limit:
                raise CometError("step limit reached")
            ins = code[pc]
            op = ins[0]
            pc += 1
            if op == "label":
                continue
            if op == "jump":
                pc = labels[ins[1]]
            elif op == "iffalse":
                if value(ins[1]) is False:
                    pc = labels[ins[2]]
            elif op == "print":
                output.append(show(value(ins[1])))
            elif op == "copy":
                env[ins[1]] = value(ins[2])
            elif op == "neg":
                env[ins[1]] = -value(ins[2])
            elif op == "not":
                env[ins[1]] = not value(ins[2])
            else:
                env[ins[1]] = TAC_OPS[op](value(ins[2]), value(ins[3]))
    except CometError as e:
        return output, str(e)
    return output, None


class Lowerer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.code = []
        self.temps = 0
        self.labels = 0

    def new_temp(self):
        self.temps += 1
        return f"%{self.temps}"

    def new_label(self):
        self.labels += 1
        return f"L{self.labels}"

    def emit(self, *ins):
        self.code.append(ins)

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, (Num, Bool)):
            return e.value
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            return e.name
        if isinstance(e, Unary):
            a = self.expr(e.expr)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("neg" if e.op == "-" else "not", t, a)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "and":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, end)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "or":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            right = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, right)
            self.emit("jump", end)
            self.emit("label", right)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary):
            a = self.expr(e.left)
            b = self.expr(e.right)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit(e.op, t, a, b)
            return t
        raise CometError(f"{type(e).__name__} is not part of the IR")

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, (Let, Assign)):
            self.emit("copy", s.name, self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, Print):
            self.emit("print", self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            self.expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            for inner in s.stmts:
                self.stmt(inner)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            if s.else_ is None:
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("label", end)
            else:
                other = self.new_label()
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, other)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("jump", end)
                self.emit("label", other)
                self.stmt(s.else_)
                self.emit("label", end)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            top = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("label", top)
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
            self.stmt(s.body)
            self.emit("jump", top)
            self.emit("label", end)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(s).__name__} is not part of the IR")


def lower(program):
    lowerer = Lowerer()
    for s in program.stmts:
        lowerer.stmt(s)
    return lowerer.code


def build_cfg(code):
    leaders = set()
    for i, ins in enumerate(code):
        if i == 0 or ins[0] == "label":
            leaders.add(i)
        if ins[0] in ("jump", "iffalse") and i + 1 < len(code):
            leaders.add(i + 1)
    starts = sorted(leaders)
    ends = starts[1:] + [len(code)]
    blocks = [code[s:e] for s, e in zip(starts, ends)]
    block_of = {b[0][1]: i for i, b in enumerate(blocks) if b[0][0] == "label"}
    succ = []
    for i, block in enumerate(blocks):
        last = block[-1]
        out = set()
        if last[0] == "jump":
            out.add(block_of[last[1]])
        else:
            if last[0] == "iffalse":
                out.add(block_of[last[2]])
            if i + 1 < len(blocks):
                out.add(i + 1)
        succ.append(sorted(out))
    return blocks, succ


def tac(source):
    return lower(parse_program(tokenize(source)))


def defs_uses(ins):
    op = ins[0]
    if op in ("label", "jump"):
        return None, []
    if op in ("print", "iffalse"):
        return None, [ins[1]] if isinstance(ins[1], str) else []
    return ins[1], [a for a in ins[2:] if isinstance(a, str)]


def liveness(blocks, succ):
    use = []
    define = []
    for block in blocks:
        u, d = set(), set()
        for ins in block:
            dst, uses = defs_uses(ins)
            u |= {a for a in uses if a not in d}
            if dst is not None:
                d.add(dst)
        use.append(u)
        define.append(d)
    live_in = [set() for _ in blocks]
    live_out = [set() for _ in blocks]
    for i in reversed(range(len(blocks))):
        out = set()
        for j in succ[i]:
            out |= live_in[j]
        live_out[i] = out
        live_in[i] = use[i] | (out - define[i])
    return live_in, live_out
--- solution
from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens
