class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())

def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()



def parse_expr(tokens):
    parser = Parser(tokens)
    tree = parser.expr()
    if parser.peek().kind != "EOF":
        raise parser.error("expected end of input")
    return tree


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


def undefined_names(source):
    program = parse_program(tokenize(source))
    top_level = set()
    for s in program.stmts:
        if isinstance(s, (Let, Fn)):
            top_level.add(s.name)
    found = []
    scopes = [set()]
    depth = 0

    def known(name):
        if any(name in scope for scope in scopes):
            return True
        return depth > 0 and name in top_level

    def expr(e):
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            if not known(e.name):
                found.append(e.name)
        elif isinstance(e, Unary):
            expr(e.expr)
        elif isinstance(e, Binary):
            expr(e.left)
            expr(e.right)
        elif isinstance(e, Call):
            expr(e.callee)
            for a in e.args:
                expr(a)

    def block(b, names=()):
        scopes.append(set(names))
        for s in b.stmts:
            stmt(s)
        scopes.pop()

    def stmt(s):
        nonlocal depth
        if isinstance(s, Let):
            expr(s.expr)
            scopes[-1].add(s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, Assign):
            expr(s.expr)
            if not known(s.name):
                found.append(s.name)
        elif isinstance(s, (Print, ExprStmt)):
            expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, Return):
            if s.expr is not None:
                expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            expr(s.cond)
            block(s.then)
            if isinstance(s.else_, If):
                stmt(s.else_)
            elif s.else_ is not None:
                block(s.else_)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            expr(s.cond)
            block(s.body)
        elif isinstance(s, Fn):
            scopes[-1].add(s.name)
            depth += 1
            block(s.body, [p for p, _ in s.params])
            depth -= 1

    for s in program.stmts:
        stmt(s)
    return found
--- check case | The example
undefined_names("let a = b; fn f(p) { print p + later + r; } let later = 1; if a { let t = 1; } print t;")
=> ["b", "r", "t"]
--- check case | A let's own name is not in scope in its initialiser, and blocks end
undefined_names("let x = x + 1; while true { let y = 2; y = y + 1; } y = 3;")
=> ["x", "y"]
--- check case | Recursion, parameters, nested functions and assignment targets
undefined_names("fn fact(n) { if n < 2 { return 1; } return n * fact(n - 1); } fn outer(a) { fn inner(b) { return a + b + c; } total = inner(a); return inner; }")
=> ["c", "total"]
--- check case | Late binding is only inside functions
undefined_names("print later; fn g() { return later + g(); } let later = 5; print g();")
=> ["later"]
--- check case | else-if chains, calls, and repeated names
undefined_names("let k = 1; if k > 1 { print q; } else if q(k, z) { let q = 2; print q; } else { print z; } print ok(ok);")
=> ["q", "q", "z", "z", "ok", "ok"]
--- check case | A correct program
undefined_names("let s = 0; let i = 0; while i < 3 { let sq = i * i; s = s + sq; i = i + 1; } print s;")
=> []

+++ problem | Folding branches out of a control-flow graph
--- task
After constant propagation, some `iffalse` instructions test a constant. Write `simplify_branches(code)` for lesson 13's three-address code (the starter gives `lower`, `tac(source)`, `build_cfg` and `run_tac`). Repeat rounds of these four steps until a round changes nothing, and return the result:

1. **Fold branches:** remove every `('iffalse', True, L)` (it never jumps), and replace every `('iffalse', False, L)` by `('jump', L)`.
2. **Remove unreachable blocks:** build the CFG of the result and keep only the blocks reachable from block 0, in order.
3. **Remove jumps to the next instruction:** drop every `('jump', L)` immediately followed by `('label', L)`.
4. **Remove unused labels:** drop every `('label', L)` that no `jump` or `iffalse` targets.

The result must print what the original prints. For example, `simplify_branches(tac("if true { print 1; } else { print 2; } print 3;"))` is `[('print', 1), ('print', 3)]`.
--- starter
from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())

def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()



def parse_expr(tokens):
    parser = Parser(tokens)
    tree = parser.expr()
    if parser.peek().kind != "EOF":
        raise parser.error("expected end of input")
    return tree


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


TAC_OPS = {
    "+": lambda a, b: a + b,
    "-": lambda a, b: a - b,
    "*": lambda a, b: a * b,
    "/": comet_div,
    "%": comet_mod,
    "==": lambda a, b: a == b,
    "!=": lambda a, b: a != b,
    "<": lambda a, b: a < b,
    "<=": lambda a, b: a <= b,
    ">": lambda a, b: a > b,
    ">=": lambda a, b: a >= b,
}


def run_tac(code, limit=200000):
    labels = {ins[1]: i for i, ins in enumerate(code) if ins[0] == "label"}
    env = {}
    output = []

    def value(a):
        if isinstance(a, str):
            if a not in env:
                raise CometError(f"undefined variable {a}")
            return env[a]
        return a

    pc = 0
    steps = 0
    try:
        while pc < len(code):
            steps += 1
            if steps > limit:
                raise CometError("step limit reached")
            ins = code[pc]
            op = ins[0]
            pc += 1
            if op == "label":
                continue
            if op == "jump":
                pc = labels[ins[1]]
            elif op == "iffalse":
                if value(ins[1]) is False:
                    pc = labels[ins[2]]
            elif op == "print":
                output.append(show(value(ins[1])))
            elif op == "copy":
                env[ins[1]] = value(ins[2])
            elif op == "neg":
                env[ins[1]] = -value(ins[2])
            elif op == "not":
                env[ins[1]] = not value(ins[2])
            else:
                env[ins[1]] = TAC_OPS[op](value(ins[2]), value(ins[3]))
    except CometError as e:
        return output, str(e)
    return output, None


class Lowerer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.code = []
        self.temps = 0
        self.labels = 0

    def new_temp(self):
        self.temps += 1
        return f"%{self.temps}"

    def new_label(self):
        self.labels += 1
        return f"L{self.labels}"

    def emit(self, *ins):
        self.code.append(ins)

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, (Num, Bool)):
            return e.value
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            return e.name
        if isinstance(e, Unary):
            a = self.expr(e.expr)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("neg" if e.op == "-" else "not", t, a)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "and":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, end)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "or":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            right = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, right)
            self.emit("jump", end)
            self.emit("label", right)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary):
            a = self.expr(e.left)
            b = self.expr(e.right)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit(e.op, t, a, b)
            return t
        raise CometError(f"{type(e).__name__} is not part of the IR")

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, (Let, Assign)):
            self.emit("copy", s.name, self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, Print):
            self.emit("print", self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            self.expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            for inner in s.stmts:
                self.stmt(inner)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            if s.else_ is None:
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("label", end)
            else:
                other = self.new_label()
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, other)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("jump", end)
                self.emit("label", other)
                self.stmt(s.else_)
                self.emit("label", end)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            top = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("label", top)
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
            self.stmt(s.body)
            self.emit("jump", top)
            self.emit("label", end)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(s).__name__} is not part of the IR")


def lower(program):
    lowerer = Lowerer()
    for s in program.stmts:
        lowerer.stmt(s)
    return lowerer.code


def build_cfg(code):
    leaders = set()
    for i, ins in enumerate(code):
        if i == 0 or ins[0] == "label":
            leaders.add(i)
        if ins[0] in ("jump", "iffalse") and i + 1 < len(code):
            leaders.add(i + 1)
    starts = sorted(leaders)
    ends = starts[1:] + [len(code)]
    blocks = [code[s:e] for s, e in zip(starts, ends)]
    block_of = {b[0][1]: i for i, b in enumerate(blocks) if b[0][0] == "label"}
    succ = []
    for i, block in enumerate(blocks):
        last = block[-1]
        out = set()
        if last[0] == "jump":
            out.add(block_of[last[1]])
        else:
            if last[0] == "iffalse":
                out.add(block_of[last[2]])
            if i + 1 < len(blocks):
                out.add(i + 1)
        succ.append(sorted(out))
    return blocks, succ


def tac(source):
    return lower(parse_program(tokenize(source)))


def simplify_branches(code):
    return list(code)
--- solution
from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())

def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()



def parse_expr(tokens):
    parser = Parser(tokens)
    tree = parser.expr()
    if parser.peek().kind != "EOF":
        raise parser.error("expected end of input")
    return tree


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


TAC_OPS = {
    "+": lambda a, b: a + b,
    "-": lambda a, b: a - b,
    "*": lambda a, b: a * b,
    "/": comet_div,
    "%": comet_mod,
    "==": lambda a, b: a == b,
    "!=": lambda a, b: a != b,
    "<": lambda a, b: a < b,
    "<=": lambda a, b: a <= b,
    ">": lambda a, b: a > b,
    ">=": lambda a, b: a >= b,
}


def run_tac(code, limit=200000):
    labels = {ins[1]: i for i, ins in enumerate(code) if ins[0] == "label"}
    env = {}
    output = []

    def value(a):
        if isinstance(a, str):
            if a not in env:
                raise CometError(f"undefined variable {a}")
            return env[a]
        return a

    pc = 0
    steps = 0
    try:
        while pc < len(code):
            steps += 1
            if steps > limit:
                raise CometError("step limit reached")
            ins = code[pc]
            op = ins[0]
            pc += 1
            if op == "label":
                continue
            if op == "jump":
                pc = labels[ins[1]]
            elif op == "iffalse":
                if value(ins[1]) is False:
                    pc = labels[ins[2]]
            elif op == "print":
                output.append(show(value(ins[1])))
            elif op == "copy":
                env[ins[1]] = value(ins[2])
            elif op == "neg":
                env[ins[1]] = -value(ins[2])
            elif op == "not":
                env[ins[1]] = not value(ins[2])
            else:
                env[ins[1]] = TAC_OPS[op](value(ins[2]), value(ins[3]))
    except CometError as e:
        return output, str(e)
    return output, None


class Lowerer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.code = []
        self.temps = 0
        self.labels = 0

    def new_temp(self):
        self.temps += 1
        return f"%{self.temps}"

    def new_label(self):
        self.labels += 1
        return f"L{self.labels}"

    def emit(self, *ins):
        self.code.append(ins)

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, (Num, Bool)):
            return e.value
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            return e.name
        if isinstance(e, Unary):
            a = self.expr(e.expr)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("neg" if e.op == "-" else "not", t, a)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "and":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, end)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "or":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            right = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, right)
            self.emit("jump", end)
            self.emit("label", right)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary):
            a = self.expr(e.left)
            b = self.expr(e.right)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit(e.op, t, a, b)
            return t
        raise CometError(f"{type(e).__name__} is not part of the IR")

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, (Let, Assign)):
            self.emit("copy", s.name, self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, Print):
            self.emit("print", self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            self.expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            for inner in s.stmts:
                self.stmt(inner)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            if s.else_ is None:
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("label", end)
            else:
                other = self.new_label()
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, other)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("jump", end)
                self.emit("label", other)
                self.stmt(s.else_)
                self.emit("label", end)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            top = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("label", top)
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
            self.stmt(s.body)
            self.emit("jump", top)
            self.emit("label", end)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(s).__name__} is not part of the IR")


def lower(program):
    lowerer = Lowerer()
    for s in program.stmts:
        lowerer.stmt(s)
    return lowerer.code


def build_cfg(code):
    leaders = set()
    for i, ins in enumerate(code):
        if i == 0 or ins[0] == "label":
            leaders.add(i)
        if ins[0] in ("jump", "iffalse") and i + 1 < len(code):
            leaders.add(i + 1)
    starts = sorted(leaders)
    ends = starts[1:] + [len(code)]
    blocks = [code[s:e] for s, e in zip(starts, ends)]
    block_of = {b[0][1]: i for i, b in enumerate(blocks) if b[0][0] == "label"}
    succ = []
    for i, block in enumerate(blocks):
        last = block[-1]
        out = set()
        if last[0] == "jump":
            out.add(block_of[last[1]])
        else:
            if last[0] == "iffalse":
                out.add(block_of[last[2]])
            if i + 1 < len(blocks):
                out.add(i + 1)
        succ.append(sorted(out))
    return blocks, succ


def tac(source):
    return lower(parse_program(tokenize(source)))


def simplify_branches(code):
    code = list(code)
    while True:
        folded = []
        for ins in code:
            if ins[0] == "iffalse" and not isinstance(ins[1], str):
                if ins[1] is False:
                    folded.append(("jump", ins[2]))
                continue
            folded.append(ins)
        blocks, succ = build_cfg(folded)
        seen = set()
        work = [0] if blocks else []
        while work:
            b = work.pop()
            if b not in seen:
                seen.add(b)
                work.extend(succ[b])
        kept = [ins for i, block in enumerate(blocks) if i in seen for ins in block]
        short = []
        for i, ins in enumerate(kept):
            if ins[0] == "jump" and i + 1 < len(kept) and kept[i + 1] == ("label", ins[1]):
                continue
            short.append(ins)
        targets = {ins[-1] for ins in short if ins[0] in ("jump", "iffalse")}
        out = [ins for ins in short if ins[0] != "label" or ins[1] in targets]
        if out == code:
            return out
        code = out
--- check case | The example
simplify_branches(tac("if true { print 1; } else { print 2; } print 3;"))
=> [('print', 1), ('print', 3)]
--- check case | while true keeps its loop, and loses its test and dead branch
simplify_branches(tac("while true { print 1; if false { print 2; } else { print 3; } }"))
=> [('label', 'L1'), ('print', 1), ('print', 3), ('jump', 'L1')]
--- check case | while false disappears; real conditions stay
simplify_branches(tac("let x = 1; if x > 0 { print x; } while false { print 0; }"))
=> [('copy', 'x', 1), ('>', '%1', 'x', 0), ('iffalse', '%1', 'L1'), ('print', 'x'), ('label', 'L1')]
--- check case | Code with nothing to fold is unchanged, and empty code
(simplify_branches(tac("let i = 0; while i < 2 { i = i + 1; } print i;")) == tac("let i = 0; while i < 2 { i = i + 1; } print i;"), simplify_branches([]))
=> (True, [])
--- check test | Behaviour is kept on nested constant conditions
all(run_tac(simplify_branches(tac(s))) == run_tac(tac(s)) for s in ["let n = 0; while n < 4 { if true { n = n + 1; } else { n = n - 1; } if false or n == 2 { print n; } } print n;", "if false { print 1; } else if true { print 2; } else { print 3; }", "let a = 5; if true and a > 3 { print a; }"])
--- check test | The result has no constant tests left
(lambda c: not any(ins[0] == "iffalse" and not isinstance(ins[1], str) for ins in c) and len(c) == 2)(simplify_branches(tac("if false { print 1; } else if true { print 2; } else { print 3; } print 4;")))

+++ problem | From three-address code to stack bytecode
--- task
Some compilers optimise on three-address code and then emit bytecode for a stack VM. Write `tac_to_bytecode(code)`, which translates lesson 13's three-address code into lesson 15's bytecode; the starter gives `lower`, `tac(source)`, `run_tac`, the VM and `run_code`. Every name, temporaries included, becomes a VM variable, written with `DEFINE` (which creates or replaces it in the one global environment).

- An operand is pushed with `('LOAD', name)` or `('CONST', value)`.
- `('copy', d, a)`: push a, `('DEFINE', d)`. `('neg', d, a)` and `('not', d, a)`: push a, `('NEG',)` or `('NOT',)`, `('DEFINE', d)`. `(op, d, a, b)`: push a, push b, the VM instruction for op (`+` is `ADD`, `<=` is `LE`, …), `('DEFINE', d)`.
- `('print', a)`: push a, `('PRINT',)`.
- `('label', L)` emits nothing, but marks the index of the next instruction emitted. `('jump', L)` is `('JUMP', index of L)`; `('iffalse', a, L)` is push a, `('JUMP_IF_FALSE', index of L)`. A label may come before or after the jumps that use it.
- End with `('HALT',)`; a label at the very end marks the index of that `HALT`.

For example, `tac_to_bytecode(tac("let a = b + 1; print a;"))` is `[('LOAD', 'b'), ('CONST', 1), ('ADD',), ('DEFINE', '%1'), ('LOAD', '%1'), ('DEFINE', 'a'), ('LOAD', 'a'), ('PRINT',), ('HALT',)]`.
--- starter
from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens

class ParseError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

COMPARE = ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=")
TYPES = ("int", "bool", "str")

class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens):
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.pos = 0

    def peek(self, ahead=0):
        return self.tokens[min(self.pos + ahead, len(self.tokens) - 1)]

    def at(self, *texts):
        tok = self.peek()
        return tok.kind in ("OP", "KEYWORD") and tok.text in texts

    def advance(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "EOF":
            self.pos += 1
        return tok

    def error(self, message):
        tok = self.peek()
        return ParseError(message, tok.line, tok.col)

    def expect(self, text):
        if not self.at(text):
            raise self.error(f"expected '{text}'")
        return self.advance()

    def expr(self):
        return self.or_expr()

    def or_expr(self):
        left = self.and_expr()
        while self.at("or"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.and_expr())
        return left

    def and_expr(self):
        left = self.not_expr()
        while self.at("and"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.not_expr())
        return left

    def not_expr(self):
        if self.at("not"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("not", self.not_expr())
        return self.compare()

    def compare(self):
        left = self.sum()
        if self.at(*COMPARE):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.sum())
            if self.at(*COMPARE):
                raise self.error("comparisons cannot be chained")
        return left

    def sum(self):
        left = self.product()
        while self.at("+", "-"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.product())
        return left

    def product(self):
        left = self.unary()
        while self.at("*", "/", "%"):
            op = self.advance().text
            left = Binary(op, left, self.unary())
        return left

    def unary(self):
        if self.at("-"):
            self.advance()
            return Unary("-", self.unary())
        return self.call()

    def call(self):
        expr = self.primary()
        while self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            args = []
            if not self.at(")"):
                args.append(self.expr())
                while self.at(","):
                    self.advance()
                    args.append(self.expr())
            self.expect(")")
            expr = Call(expr, args)
        return expr

    def primary(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return Num(int(tok.text))
        if tok.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return Str(tok.text)
        if tok.kind == "IDENT":
            self.advance()
            return Var(tok.text)
        if self.at("true", "false"):
            self.advance()
            return Bool(tok.text == "true")
        if self.at("("):
            self.advance()
            inner = self.expr()
            self.expect(")")
            return inner
        raise self.error("expected an expression")

    def program(self):
        stmts = []
        while self.peek().kind != "EOF":
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        return Program(stmts)

    def statement(self):
        if self.at("let"):
            return self.let_stmt()
        if self.at("print"):
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Print(value)
        if self.at("if"):
            return self.if_stmt()
        if self.at("while"):
            self.advance()
            cond = self.expr()
            return While(cond, self.block())
        if self.at("fn"):
            return self.fn_stmt()
        if self.at("return"):
            self.advance()
            value = None if self.at(";") else self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Return(value)
        nxt = self.peek(1)
        if self.peek().kind == "IDENT" and nxt.kind == "OP" and nxt.text == "=":
            name = self.advance().text
            self.advance()
            value = self.expr()
            self.expect(";")
            return Assign(name, value)
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return ExprStmt(value)

    def name(self):
        if self.peek().kind != "IDENT":
            raise self.error("expected a name")
        return self.advance().text

    def type_name(self):
        tok = self.peek()
        if tok.kind != "IDENT" or tok.text not in TYPES:
            raise self.error("expected a type")
        return self.advance().text

    def let_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        self.expect("=")
        value = self.expr()
        self.expect(";")
        return Let(name, type_, value)

    def if_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        cond = self.expr()
        then = self.block()
        else_ = None
        if self.at("else"):
            self.advance()
            else_ = self.if_stmt() if self.at("if") else self.block()
        return If(cond, then, else_)

    def block(self):
        self.expect("{")
        stmts = []
        while not self.at("}"):
            if self.peek().kind == "EOF":
                raise self.error("expected '}'")
            stmts.append(self.statement())
        self.advance()
        return Block(stmts)

    def param(self):
        name = self.name()
        type_ = None
        if self.at(":"):
            self.advance()
            type_ = self.type_name()
        return (name, type_)

    def fn_stmt(self):
        self.advance()
        name = self.name()
        self.expect("(")
        params = []
        if not self.at(")"):
            params.append(self.param())
            while self.at(","):
                self.advance()
                params.append(self.param())
        self.expect(")")
        ret = None
        if self.at("->"):
            self.advance()
            ret = self.type_name()
        return Fn(name, params, ret, self.block())

def parse_program(tokens):
    return Parser(tokens).program()



def parse_expr(tokens):
    parser = Parser(tokens)
    tree = parser.expr()
    if parser.peek().kind != "EOF":
        raise parser.error("expected end of input")
    return tree


class CometError(Exception):
    pass


def comet_div(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        raise CometError("division by zero")
    q = abs(a) // abs(b)
    return q if (a < 0) == (b < 0) else -q


def comet_mod(a, b):
    return a - b * comet_div(a, b)


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    return str(value)


TAC_OPS = {
    "+": lambda a, b: a + b,
    "-": lambda a, b: a - b,
    "*": lambda a, b: a * b,
    "/": comet_div,
    "%": comet_mod,
    "==": lambda a, b: a == b,
    "!=": lambda a, b: a != b,
    "<": lambda a, b: a < b,
    "<=": lambda a, b: a <= b,
    ">": lambda a, b: a > b,
    ">=": lambda a, b: a >= b,
}


def run_tac(code, limit=200000):
    labels = {ins[1]: i for i, ins in enumerate(code) if ins[0] == "label"}
    env = {}
    output = []

    def value(a):
        if isinstance(a, str):
            if a not in env:
                raise CometError(f"undefined variable {a}")
            return env[a]
        return a

    pc = 0
    steps = 0
    try:
        while pc < len(code):
            steps += 1
            if steps > limit:
                raise CometError("step limit reached")
            ins = code[pc]
            op = ins[0]
            pc += 1
            if op == "label":
                continue
            if op == "jump":
                pc = labels[ins[1]]
            elif op == "iffalse":
                if value(ins[1]) is False:
                    pc = labels[ins[2]]
            elif op == "print":
                output.append(show(value(ins[1])))
            elif op == "copy":
                env[ins[1]] = value(ins[2])
            elif op == "neg":
                env[ins[1]] = -value(ins[2])
            elif op == "not":
                env[ins[1]] = not value(ins[2])
            else:
                env[ins[1]] = TAC_OPS[op](value(ins[2]), value(ins[3]))
    except CometError as e:
        return output, str(e)
    return output, None


class Lowerer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.code = []
        self.temps = 0
        self.labels = 0

    def new_temp(self):
        self.temps += 1
        return f"%{self.temps}"

    def new_label(self):
        self.labels += 1
        return f"L{self.labels}"

    def emit(self, *ins):
        self.code.append(ins)

    def expr(self, e):
        if isinstance(e, (Num, Bool)):
            return e.value
        if isinstance(e, Var):
            return e.name
        if isinstance(e, Unary):
            a = self.expr(e.expr)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("neg" if e.op == "-" else "not", t, a)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "and":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, end)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary) and e.op == "or":
            left = self.expr(e.left)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit("copy", t, left)
            right = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("iffalse", t, right)
            self.emit("jump", end)
            self.emit("label", right)
            self.emit("copy", t, self.expr(e.right))
            self.emit("label", end)
            return t
        if isinstance(e, Binary):
            a = self.expr(e.left)
            b = self.expr(e.right)
            t = self.new_temp()
            self.emit(e.op, t, a, b)
            return t
        raise CometError(f"{type(e).__name__} is not part of the IR")

    def stmt(self, s):
        if isinstance(s, (Let, Assign)):
            self.emit("copy", s.name, self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, Print):
            self.emit("print", self.expr(s.expr))
        elif isinstance(s, ExprStmt):
            self.expr(s.expr)
        elif isinstance(s, Block):
            for inner in s.stmts:
                self.stmt(inner)
        elif isinstance(s, If):
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            if s.else_ is None:
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("label", end)
            else:
                other = self.new_label()
                end = self.new_label()
                self.emit("iffalse", cond, other)
                self.stmt(s.then)
                self.emit("jump", end)
                self.emit("label", other)
                self.stmt(s.else_)
                self.emit("label", end)
        elif isinstance(s, While):
            top = self.new_label()
            end = self.new_label()
            self.emit("label", top)
            cond = self.expr(s.cond)
            self.emit("iffalse", cond, end)
            self.stmt(s.body)
            self.emit("jump", top)
            self.emit("label", end)
        else:
            raise CometError(f"{type(s).__name__} is not part of the IR")


def lower(program):
    lowerer = Lowerer()
    for s in program.stmts:
        lowerer.stmt(s)
    return lowerer.code


def build_cfg(code):
    leaders = set()
    for i, ins in enumerate(code):
        if i == 0 or ins[0] == "label":
            leaders.add(i)
        if ins[0] in ("jump", "iffalse") and i + 1 < len(code):
            leaders.add(i + 1)
    starts = sorted(leaders)
    ends = starts[1:] + [len(code)]
    blocks = [code[s:e] for s, e in zip(starts, ends)]
    block_of = {b[0][1]: i for i, b in enumerate(blocks) if b[0][0] == "label"}
    succ = []
    for i, block in enumerate(blocks):
        last = block[-1]
        out = set()
        if last[0] == "jump":
            out.add(block_of[last[1]])
        else:
            if last[0] == "iffalse":
                out.add(block_of[last[2]])
            if i + 1 < len(blocks):
                out.add(i + 1)
        succ.append(sorted(out))
    return blocks, succ


def tac(source):
    return lower(parse_program(tokenize(source)))


def type_name(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "bool"
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return "int"
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return "str"
    if value is None:
        return "nothing"
    return "fn"


class Environment:
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        self.values = {}
        self.parent = parent

    def define(self, name, value):
        self.values[name] = value

    def lookup(self, name):
        env = self
        while env is not None:
            if name in env.values:
                return env.values[name]
            env = env.parent
        raise CometError(f"undefined variable {name}")

    def assign(self, name, value):
        env = self
        while env is not None:
            if name in env.values:
                env.values[name] = value
                return
            env = env.parent
        raise CometError(f"assignment to undeclared variable {name}")


class FunctionCode:
    def __init__(self, name, params, code):
        self.name = name
        self.params = params
        self.code = code

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"FunctionCode({self.name!r}, {self.params!r}, {self.code!r})"

    def __eq__(self, other):
        return isinstance(other, FunctionCode) and (self.name, self.params, self.code) == (other.name, other.params, other.code)


class Closure:
    def __init__(self, decl, env):
        self.decl = decl
        self.env = env


class Frame:
    def __init__(self, code, pc, env, base):
        self.code = code
        self.pc = pc
        self.env = env
        self.base = base


class VM:
    def __init__(self):
        self.stack = []
        self.frames = []
        self.globals = Environment()
        self.output = []
        self.steps = 0

    def pop(self):
        return self.stack.pop()

    def need(self, wanted, value, op):
        if type_name(value) != wanted:
            raise CometError(f"'{op}' needs {wanted}, not {type_name(value)}")

    def run(self, code):
        pc = 0
        env = self.globals
        while True:
            if pc >= len(code):
                return
            ins = code[pc]
            op = ins[0]
            pc += 1
            self.steps += 1
            if op == "CONST":
                value = ins[1]
                if isinstance(value, FunctionCode):
                    value = Closure(value, env)
                self.stack.append(value)
            elif op == "LOAD":
                self.stack.append(env.lookup(ins[1]))
            elif op == "STORE":
                env.assign(ins[1], self.pop())
            elif op == "DEFINE":
                env.define(ins[1], self.pop())
            elif op in ("ADD", "SUB", "MUL", "DIV", "MOD", "LT", "LE", "GT", "GE", "EQ", "NE"):
                b = self.pop()
                a = self.pop()
                self.stack.append(self.binary(op, a, b))
            elif op == "NEG":
                a = self.pop()
                self.need("int", a, "-")
                self.stack.append(-a)
            elif op == "NOT":
                a = self.pop()
                self.need("bool", a, "not")
                self.stack.append(not a)
            elif op == "JUMP":
                pc = ins[1]
            elif op == "JUMP_IF_FALSE":
                cond = self.pop()
                self.need("bool", cond, "condition")
                if not cond:
                    pc = ins[1]
            elif op == "PRINT":
                value = self.pop()
                if value is None:
                    raise CometError("cannot print nothing")
                if isinstance(value, Closure):
                    self.output.append(f"<fn {value.decl.name}>")
                else:
                    self.output.append(show(value))
            elif op == "POP":
                self.pop()
            elif op == "CALL":
                argc = ins[1]
                args = self.stack[len(self.stack) - argc:]
                del self.stack[len(self.stack) - argc:]
                callee = self.pop()
                if not isinstance(callee, Closure):
                    raise CometError(f"cannot call a value of type {type_name(callee)}")
                fn = callee.decl
                if len(fn.params) != argc:
                    raise CometError(f"{fn.name} takes {len(fn.params)} arguments, not {argc}")
                self.frames.append(Frame(code, pc, env, len(self.stack)))
                env = Environment(callee.env)
                for name, value in zip(fn.params, args):
                    env.define(name, value)
                code = fn.code
                pc = 0
            elif op == "RET":
                if not self.frames:
                    raise CometError("return outside a function")
                value = self.pop()
                frame = self.frames.pop()
                del self.stack[frame.base:]
                self.stack.append(value)
                code, pc, env = frame.code, frame.pc, frame.env
            elif op == "HALT":
                return
            else:
                raise CometError(f"unknown instruction {op}")

    def binary(self, op, a, b):
        if op in ("EQ", "NE"):
            if type_name(a) != type_name(b):
                raise CometError(f"cannot compare {type_name(a)} with {type_name(b)}")
            return (a == b) == (op == "EQ")
        if op == "ADD" and type_name(a) == "str" and type_name(b) == "str":
            return a + b
        self.need("int", a, op)
        self.need("int", b, op)
        if op == "ADD":
            return a + b
        if op == "SUB":
            return a - b
        if op == "MUL":
            return a * b
        if op == "DIV":
            return comet_div(a, b)
        if op == "MOD":
            return comet_mod(a, b)
        if op == "LT":
            return a < b
        if op == "LE":
            return a <= b
        if op == "GT":
            return a > b
        return a >= b


def run_code(code):
    vm = VM()
    try:
        vm.run(code)
    except CometError as e:
        return vm.output, str(e)
    return vm.output, None


def tac_to_bytecode(code):
    return [("HALT",)]

from dataclasses import dataclass

KEYWORDS = {"let", "fn", "return", "if", "else", "while", "print",
            "true", "false", "and", "or", "not"}
TWO_CHAR = {"==", "!=", "<=", ">=", "->"}
ONE_CHAR = set("+-*/%<>=(){},;:")
ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "n": "\n"}
DIGITS = "0123456789"
LETTERS = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"

@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    text: str
    line: int
    col: int

class LexError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message, line, col):
        super().__init__(f"{line}:{col}: {message}")
        self.line = line
        self.col = col

def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    line = 1
    col = 1
    n = len(source)

    def advance(count):
        nonlocal i, line, col
        for _ in range(count):
            if source[i] == "\n":
                line += 1
                col = 1
            else:
                col += 1
            i += 1

    while i < n:
        ch = source[i]
        start_line, start_col = line, col
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            advance(1)
        elif ch == "#":
            while i < n and source[i] != "\n":
                advance(1)
        elif ch in DIGITS:
            j = i
            while j < n and source[j] in DIGITS:
                j += 1
            tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", source[i:j], start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch in LETTERS:
            j = i
            while j < n and (source[j] in LETTERS or source[j] in DIGITS):
                j += 1
            word = source[i:j]
            kind = "KEYWORD" if word in KEYWORDS else "IDENT"
            tokens.append(Token(kind, word, start_line, start_col))
            advance(j - i)
        elif ch == '"':
            advance(1)
            chars = []
            while True:
                if i >= n or source[i] == "\n":
                    raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                c = source[i]
                if c == '"':
                    advance(1)
                    break
                if c == "\\":
                    if i + 1 >= n or source[i + 1] == "\n":
                        raise LexError("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
                    if source[i + 1] not in ESCAPES:
                        raise LexError("unknown escape", line, col)
                    chars.append(ESCAPES[source[i + 1]])
                    advance(2)
                else:
                    chars.append(c)
                    advance(1)
            tokens.append(Token("STRING", "".join(chars), start_line, start_col))
        elif source[i:i + 2] in TWO_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", source[i:i + 2], start_line, start_col))
            advance(2)
        elif ch in ONE_CHAR:
            tokens.append(Token("OP", ch, start_line, start_col))
            advance(1)
        else:
            raise LexError(f"unexpected character {ch!r}", start_line, start_col)
    tokens.append(Token("EOF", "", line, col))
    return tokens
